+class BacktestRunner:
+    """Run registered strategies over a supplied replay feed and simulator."""
+    def __init__(self, registry: StrategyRegistry, feed: HistoricalReplayFeed,
+                 clock: ReplayClock, execution: HistoricalExecutionSimulator,
+                 *, scheduler: StrategyScheduler | None = None,
+                 intent_factory: Callable[..., Any] | None = None,
+                 budget_policy: Any = None, eligibility_policy: Any = None,
+                 position_coordinator: Any = None, cycle_accounting: Any = None,
+                 protection_math: Any = None) -> None:
+        self.registry, self.feed, self.clock, self.execution = registry, feed, clock, execution
+        self.scheduler = scheduler or StrategyScheduler(clock)
+        self.intent_factory = intent_factory
+        self.policies = (budget_policy, eligibility_policy, position_coordinator, cycle_accounting, protection_math)
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _reject_real_broker(broker: object | None, execution: object) -> None:
+        for candidate in (broker, execution):
+            if candidate is None:
+                continue
+            module = type(candidate).__module__.lower()
+            name = type(candidate).__name__.lower()
+            environment = str(getattr(candidate, "environment", "")).lower()
+            if "alpaca" in module or "alpaca" in name or environment in {"paper", "live"}:
+                raise ValueError("real Alpaca/paper/live broker clients are refused in backtests")
+
+    async def run(self, request: BacktestRequest) -> BacktestResult:
+        self._reject_real_broker(request.broker, self.execution)
+        if self.feed.seed != request.seed:
+            raise ValueError("request seed must match the injected replay feed seed")
+        if getattr(self.execution, "_feed", self.feed) is not self.feed or getattr(
+            self.execution, "_clock", self.clock
+        ) is not self.clock:
+            raise ValueError("execution simulator must share the injected replay feed and clock")
+        def inspect_broker_config(value: Any, key: str = "") -> None:
+            if isinstance(value, Mapping):
+                for child_key, child_value in value.items():
+                    inspect_broker_config(child_value, str(child_key).lower())
+            elif key in {"broker", "broker_type", "provider", "environment", "mode"}:
+                if isinstance(value, str) and value.strip().lower() in {
+                    "alpaca", "alpaca_paper", "paper", "live", "alpaca_live"
+                }:
+                    raise ValueError("configuration resolves to a real Alpaca/paper/live broker")
+                if not isinstance(value, str):
+                    self._reject_real_broker(value, None)
+        inspect_broker_config(request.config)
+        role = PeriodRole(request.period_role)
+        provenance = self.feed.provenance
+        strategies = []
+        for strategy_id in request.strategy_ids:
+            cls = self.registry.get(strategy_id, request.strategy_versions.get(strategy_id))
+            strategies.append(cls)
+        for symbol in request.symbols:
+            self.scheduler.watch(symbol)
+            for cls in strategies:
+                self.scheduler.register(
+                    symbol=symbol, strategy_id=cls.spec.strategy_id, side=cls.spec.side,
+                    triggers=(StrategyTrigger(TriggerKind.CANDLE_CLOSED,
+                                               timeframe=cls.spec.trigger_timeframe),),
+                )
+        effective = dict(request.config)
+        assumptions = self.execution.assumptions
+        amap = dict(assumptions.as_mapping())
+        effective.update({"seed": request.seed, "strategy_ids": list(request.strategy_ids),
+                          "strategy_versions": {c.spec.strategy_id:c.spec.version for c in strategies},
+                          "strategy_params": request.strategy_params,
+                          "execution_assumptions": amap,
+                          "starting_capital": request.starting_capital,
+                          "symbols": sorted(request.symbols),
+                          "window_start": request.window_start,
+                          "window_end": request.window_end})
+        digest = config_hash(effective)
+        if role is PeriodRole.HOLDOUT:
+            lock = request.holdout_lock
+            if lock is None:
+                raise HoldoutViolationError("HOLDOUT requires an explicit holdout lock token")
+            if lock.research_config_hash != digest:
+                raise HoldoutViolationError("holdout config differs from locked research configuration")
+            if request.window_start.astimezone(UTC) < lock.window_start or request.window_end.astimezone(UTC) > lock.window_end:
+                raise HoldoutViolationError("HOLDOUT run must stay within locked holdout window")
+            access = {"token": lock.token, "accessed_at": self.clock.now()}
+        else:
+            access = None
+            lock = request.holdout_lock
+            if lock and request.window_start.astimezone(UTC) < lock.window_end and request.window_end.astimezone(UTC) > lock.window_start:
+                raise HoldoutViolationError("research/dev window overlaps locked holdout window")
+        dataset_hash = provenance.dataset_hash or ""
+        run_id = hashlib.sha256(canonical_json({"config_hash":digest,"dataset_hash":dataset_hash,
+                            "symbols":sorted(request.symbols),"start":request.window_start,
+                            "end":request.window_end,"role":role.value}).encode()).hexdigest()
+        manifest = RunManifest(run_id, request.window_start, digest, tuple(request.symbols),
+            request.window_start, request.window_end, role, code_revision(),
+            {"source":provenance.source,"feed":provenance.feed,"is_consolidated":provenance.is_consolidated,
+             "adjustment":provenance.adjustment,"point_in_time":provenance.point_in_time},
+            provenance.revision, provenance.revision, dataset_hash, str(request.starting_capital),
+            {k:v for k,v in amap.items() if k.startswith("fee_")},
+            {k:v for k,v in amap.items() if "slippage" in k},
+            {k:v for k,v in amap.items() if "fill" in k},
+            {k:v for k,v in amap.items() if "ambiguity" in k}, request.seed,
+            tuple({"name":c.spec.strategy_id,"version":c.spec.version} for c in strategies), access)
+        root = Path(request.result_directory)
+        write_manifest(manifest, root)
+        evaluations: list[Mapping[str, Any]] = []
+        signals: list[Mapping[str, Any]] = []
+        intents: list[Mapping[str, Any]] = []
+        fills: list[Mapping[str, Any]] = []
+        cycles: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+        equity_curve: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+        cash = request.starting_capital
+        quantities: dict[str, Decimal] = defaultdict(lambda: ZERO)
+        marks: dict[str, Decimal] = {}
+        open_cycles: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
+        candles_by_symbol: dict[str,list[Candle]] = defaultdict(list)
+        replay_events = [e for e in self.feed.events(symbols=request.symbols)
+                         if e.available_at and request.window_start <= e.available_at <= request.window_end]
+        trigger_rows: set[tuple[str,str,datetime]] = set()
+        state: dict[tuple[str,str],dict[str,Any]] = defaultdict(dict)
+        params = {sid: self.registry.validate_parameters(sid, request.strategy_params.get(sid, {}), request.strategy_versions.get(sid)) for sid in request.strategy_ids}
+        for ev in replay_events:
+            assert ev.available_at
+            self.clock.advance_to(ev.available_at)
+            outputs = self.execution.process_event(ev)
+            for x in outputs:
+                fill_row={"symbol":x.symbol,"side":x.side.value,"quantity":x.quantity,"price":x.price,
+                          "fee":x.fee,"time":x.fill.filled_at,"order_id":x.fill.broker_order_id,
+                          "evidence":x.evidence}
+                fills.append(fill_row)
+                signed = x.quantity if x.side.value == "BUY" else -x.quantity
+                cash += -(x.quantity*x.price+x.fee) if x.side.value == "BUY" else x.quantity*x.price-x.fee
+                quantities[x.symbol] += signed
+                marks[x.symbol] = x.price
+                if x.side.value == "BUY":
+                    if x.symbol not in open_cycles:
+                        open_cycles[x.symbol]={"cycle_id":f"{run_id}:{x.symbol}:{len(cycles)+1}",
+                                               "symbol":x.symbol,"opened_at":x.fill.filled_at,
+                                               "closed_at":None,"entry_quantity":ZERO,"exit_quantity":ZERO}
+                    open_cycles[x.symbol]["entry_quantity"] += x.quantity
+                elif x.symbol in open_cycles:
+                    open_cycles[x.symbol]["exit_quantity"] += x.quantity
+                    if quantities[x.symbol] <= ZERO:
+                        cycle=open_cycles.pop(x.symbol)
+                        cycle["closed_at"]=x.fill.filled_at
+                        cycles.append(cycle)
+                equity_curve.append({"time":x.fill.filled_at,"cash":cash,
+                    "equity":cash+sum((qty*marks.get(sym,ZERO) for sym,qty in quantities.items()),ZERO)})
+            if ev.kind != ReplayEvent.KIND_BAR or ev.candle is None:
+                continue
+            marks[ev.symbol]=ev.candle.close
+            equity_curve.append({"time":ev.available_at,"cash":cash,
+                "equity":cash+sum((qty*marks.get(sym,ZERO) for sym,qty in quantities.items()),ZERO)})
+            candles_by_symbol[ev.symbol].append(ev.candle)
+            due = self.scheduler.process(CandleClosedEvent(ev.symbol, CandleTimeframe(ev.candle.timeframe.value), ev.candle.end,
+                                                           snapshot_version=len(candles_by_symbol[ev.symbol]), due_at=ev.available_at))
+            due_ids = {(item.symbol, item.strategy_id) for item in due}
+            # Registry class specs drive closed-bar trigger cadence and evaluation.
+            for cls in strategies:
+                spec = cls.spec
+                if (ev.symbol, spec.strategy_id) not in due_ids:
+                    continue
+                if ev.candle.timeframe.value != spec.trigger_timeframe.value or len(candles_by_symbol[ev.symbol]) < max(1,spec.warmup_bars):
+                    continue
+                key=(ev.symbol,spec.strategy_id,ev.candle.start)
+                if key in trigger_rows: continue
+                trigger_rows.add(key)
+                history=tuple(candles_by_symbol[ev.symbol][-max(spec.warmup_bars+1,1):])
+                spec_tf=CandleTimeframe(spec.trigger_timeframe.value)
+                converted=tuple(StrategyCandle(c.symbol,spec_tf,c.start,c.end,c.open,c.high,c.low,c.close,
+                    c.volume,c.provenance.feed,c.provenance.is_consolidated,CandleOrigin.REPLAY,
+                    PriceBasis.RAW,CandleStatus.CLOSED,c.trade_count) for c in history)
+                session_status=self.clock.session_status()
+                age=ev.available_at-ev.candle.end
+                freshness=ContextFreshness(ev.candle.end,max(age, timedelta(0)), timedelta(minutes=5),False,None)
+                context=MarketContext(ev.symbol,ev.available_at,len(candles_by_symbol[ev.symbol]),
+                    provenance.feed,provenance.is_consolidated,PriceBasis.RAW,session_status,
+                    ev.available_at.astimezone(NEW_YORK).date().isoformat(),freshness,
+                    {spec_tf:converted},{})
+                strategy=cls()
+                evaluation: StrategyEvaluation=strategy.evaluate(context,params[spec.strategy_id],state[(ev.symbol,spec.strategy_id)])
+                state[(ev.symbol,spec.strategy_id)].update(evaluation.state_updates)
+                row={"symbol":ev.symbol,"strategy":spec.strategy_id,"version":spec.version,
+                     "time":ev.available_at,"bar_time":ev.candle.start,"signal_id":evaluation.signal_id,
+                     "reason_codes":[x.value for x in evaluation.reason_codes]}
+                evaluations.append(row)
+                if evaluation.is_signal:
+                    signals.append(row)

+        px, px, px, px, D("1000"), FEED_PROV))
+
+
+def _runner(seed: int = 7):
+    clock = ReplayClock(UTC0)
+    feed = HistoricalReplayFeed([_event(0), _event(1)], PROV, clock=clock, seed=seed)

+"""Immutable, content-addressed backtest run manifests.
+
+Manifests and run results are stored in run-scoped files by :mod:`runner`; the
+existing SQLite schema is deliberately unchanged for this task.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+import subprocess
+from dataclasses import dataclass, fields, is_dataclass
+from datetime import UTC, datetime
+from decimal import Decimal
+from enum import StrEnum
+from pathlib import Path
+from types import MappingProxyType
+from typing import Any, Mapping
+
+
+class PeriodRole(StrEnum):
+    RESEARCH = "RESEARCH"
+    DEV = "DEV"
+    HOLDOUT = "HOLDOUT"
+
+
+class HoldoutViolationError(ValueError):
+    """A holdout access or retuning rule was violated."""
+
+
+def canonical_json(value: Any) -> str:
+    """Canonical JSON for manifest/config/result hashing; rejects floats."""
+    def normalize(item: Any) -> Any:
+        if isinstance(item, datetime):
+            if item.tzinfo is None or item.utcoffset() is None:
+                raise ValueError("datetimes must be timezone-aware")
+            return item.astimezone(UTC).isoformat(timespec="microseconds").replace("+00:00", "Z")
+        if hasattr(item, "value") and isinstance(item.value, (str, int)):
+            return item.value
+        if isinstance(item, float):
+            raise TypeError("floats are not allowed in canonical backtest values")
+        if isinstance(item, Mapping):
+            return {str(k): normalize(v) for k, v in item.items()}
+        if isinstance(item, (list, tuple)):
+            return [normalize(v) for v in item]
+        if isinstance(item, (str, int, bool)) or item is None:
+            return item
+        if hasattr(item, "as_mapping"):
+            return normalize(item.as_mapping())
+        if isinstance(item, Decimal):
+            if not item.is_finite():
+                raise ValueError("non-finite Decimal is not canonical")
+            return format(item, "f")
+        if is_dataclass(item):
+            return normalize({field.name: getattr(item, field.name) for field in fields(item)})
+        raise TypeError(f"unsupported canonical value {type(item).__name__}")
+
+    return json.dumps(normalize(value), sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=True)
+
+
+def config_hash(config: Mapping[str, Any]) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(canonical_json(config).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
+
+
+def code_revision(cwd: str | Path | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Capture local git commit and dirty status without network access."""
+    try:
+        commit = subprocess.run(
+            ["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], cwd=cwd, check=True, capture_output=True,
+            text=True, timeout=2,
+        ).stdout.strip()
+        dirty = bool(subprocess.run(
+            ["git", "status", "--porcelain"], cwd=cwd, check=True, capture_output=True,
+            text=True, timeout=2,
+        ).stdout.strip())
+    except (OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError):
+        commit, dirty = "unknown", False
+    return {"commit": commit, "dirty": dirty}
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class HoldoutLock:
+    """Operator authorization and locked research/window identity."""
+    token: str
+    research_config_hash: str
+    window_start: datetime
+    window_end: datetime
+    enabled: bool = True
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        if not self.token or not self.enabled:
+            raise HoldoutViolationError("holdout access requires an enabled explicit lock token")
+        for name in ("window_start", "window_end"):
+            value = getattr(self, name)
+            if value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
+                raise ValueError(f"{name} must be timezone-aware")
+            object.__setattr__(self, name, value.astimezone(UTC))
+        if self.window_end <= self.window_start:
+            raise ValueError("holdout window must be bounded and non-empty")
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class RunManifest:
+    run_id: str
+    created_at: datetime
+    config_hash: str
+    symbols: tuple[str, ...]
+    window_start: datetime
+    window_end: datetime
+    period_role: PeriodRole
+    code_revision: Mapping[str, Any]
+    data_provenance: Mapping[str, Any]
+    data_revision: str
+    data_vintage: str
+    dataset_hash: str
+    starting_capital: str
+    fee_assumptions: Mapping[str, Any]
+    slippage_assumptions: Mapping[str, Any]
+    fill_assumptions: Mapping[str, Any]
+    ambiguity_assumptions: Mapping[str, Any]
+    seed: int
+    strategies: tuple[Mapping[str, str], ...]
+    holdout_access: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        if not self.run_id or not self.config_hash:
+            raise ValueError("run_id and config_hash are required")
+        if not isinstance(self.period_role, PeriodRole):
+            object.__setattr__(self, "period_role", PeriodRole(self.period_role))
+        for name in ("created_at", "window_start", "window_end"):
+            dt = getattr(self, name)
+            if dt.tzinfo is None or dt.utcoffset() is None:
+                raise ValueError(f"{name} must be timezone-aware")
+            object.__setattr__(self, name, dt.astimezone(UTC))
+        if self.window_end <= self.window_start:
+            raise ValueError("window must be bounded and non-empty")
+        if not 1 <= len(self.symbols) <= 10:
+            raise ValueError("manifest requires 1-10 symbols")
+        object.__setattr__(self, "symbols", tuple(sorted({s.upper() for s in self.symbols})))
+        for name in ("code_revision", "data_provenance", "fee_assumptions", "slippage_assumptions",
+                     "fill_assumptions", "ambiguity_assumptions", "holdout_access"):
+            value = getattr(self, name)
+            if value is not None:
+                object.__setattr__(self, name, MappingProxyType(dict(value)))
+        object.__setattr__(self, "strategies", tuple(MappingProxyType(dict(v)) for v in self.strategies))
+        if isinstance(self.seed, bool) or not isinstance(self.seed, int):
+            raise ValueError("seed must be int")
+
+    def canonical(self) -> str:
+        return canonical_json({field.name: getattr(self, field.name) for field in fields(self)})
+
+    @property
+    def content_hash(self) -> str:
+        return hashlib.sha256(self.canonical().encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
+
+    @classmethod
+    def from_json(cls, value: str) -> "RunManifest":
+        raw = json.loads(value)
+        for field in ("created_at", "window_start", "window_end"):
+            raw[field] = datetime.fromisoformat(raw[field].replace("Z", "+00:00"))
+        raw["period_role"] = PeriodRole(raw["period_role"])
+        raw["symbols"] = tuple(raw["symbols"])
+        raw["strategies"] = tuple(raw["strategies"])
+        return cls(**raw)
+
+
+def write_manifest(manifest: RunManifest, directory: str | Path) -> Path:
+    """Create once; exclusive creation rejects any existing run id."""
+    target = Path(directory) / f"{manifest.run_id}.manifest.json"
+    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    payload = manifest.canonical()
+    with target.open("x", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as stream:
+        stream.write(payload)
+        stream.flush()
+        os.fsync(stream.fileno())
+    return target

+def _decimal(value: Any) -> Decimal:
+    if isinstance(value, Decimal):
+        return value
+    if isinstance(value, str):
+        return Decimal(value)
+    raise TypeError("metric money, quantities and prices must be Decimal or decimal strings")
+
+
+def _dt(value: Any) -> datetime:
+    return value if isinstance(value, datetime) else datetime.fromisoformat(str(value).replace("Z", "+00:00"))
+
+
+def _trade_records(fills: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    """Pair long entries/exits FIFO, preserving costs and timestamps."""
+    queues: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(list)
+    trades: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    ordered = sorted(fills, key=lambda f: _dt(f["time"]))
+    for fill in ordered:
+        symbol = str(fill["symbol"]).upper()
+        side = str(fill["side"]).upper()
+        qty, price, fee = _decimal(fill["quantity"]), _decimal(fill["price"]), _decimal(fill.get("fee", "0"))
+        at = _dt(fill["time"])
+        if side in ("BUY", "B"):
+            queues[symbol].append({"qty": qty, "price": price, "fee": fee, "time": at,
+                                   "high": _decimal(fill.get("high", price)), "low": _decimal(fill.get("low", price)),
+                                   "entry_time": at})
+            continue
+        if side not in ("SELL", "S"):
+            continue
+        remaining = qty
+        while remaining > ZERO and queues[symbol]:
+            lot = queues[symbol][0]
+            matched = min(remaining, lot["qty"])
+            fraction = matched / qty
+            entry_fee = lot["fee"] * (matched / (matched + lot["qty"] - matched)) if lot["qty"] else ZERO
+            exit_fee = fee * fraction
+            gross = (price - lot["price"]) * matched
+            pnl = gross - entry_fee - exit_fee
+            trades.append({"symbol": symbol, "entry_time": lot["time"], "exit_time": at,
+                           "entry_price": lot["price"], "exit_price": price, "quantity": matched,
+                           "gross_pnl": gross, "costs": entry_fee + exit_fee, "pnl": pnl,
+                           "hold_duration_seconds": Decimal(str((at-lot["time"]).total_seconds())),
+                           "mfe": (lot["high"]-lot["price"]) * matched,
+                           "mae": (lot["low"]-lot["price"]) * matched})
+            lot["qty"] -= matched
+            remaining -= matched
+            if lot["qty"] == ZERO:
+                queues[symbol].pop(0)
+    return trades

+def compute_metrics(

+    *, starting_capital: Decimal,
+    seed: int = 0,

+    small_sample_threshold: int = 30,

+            item["costs"] = _decimal(item.get("costs", item["gross_pnl"]-item["pnl"]))
+            item["symbol"] = str(item.get("symbol", "UNKNOWN")).upper()
+            item["entry_time"] = _dt(item["entry_time"])
+            item["exit_time"] = _dt(item["exit_time"])

+            item["entry_price"] = _decimal(item.get("entry_price", "0"))
+            item.setdefault("hold_duration_seconds", Decimal(str((item["exit_time"]-item["entry_time"]).total_seconds())))
+            item["mfe"] = _decimal(item.get("mfe", "0"))
+            item["mae"] = _decimal(item.get("mae", "0"))
+            trades.append(item)
+    else:
+        trades = _trade_records(fills)
+    cumulative = capital
+    generated_curve: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    peak = capital
+    max_dd = ZERO
+    for trade in trades:
+        cumulative += trade["pnl"]
+        peak = max(peak, cumulative)
+        if peak:
+            max_dd = max(max_dd, (peak-cumulative)/peak)
+        generated_curve.append({"time": trade["exit_time"], "cash": cumulative, "equity": cumulative})
+    equity = tuple(curve) if curve else tuple(generated_curve)
+    net_pnl = sum((t["pnl"] for t in trades), ZERO)
+    gross_pnl = sum((t["gross_pnl"] for t in trades), ZERO)
+    gross_wins = sum((t["pnl"] for t in trades if t["pnl"] > ZERO), ZERO)
+    gross_losses = -sum((t["pnl"] for t in trades if t["pnl"] < ZERO), ZERO)
+    wins = [t["pnl"] for t in trades if t["pnl"] > ZERO]
+    losses = [t["pnl"] for t in trades if t["pnl"] < ZERO]
+    n = len(trades)
+    expectancy = net_pnl / n if n else ZERO
+    by_symbol: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(list)
+    by_month: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(list)
+    by_tod: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(list)
+    for t in trades:
+        local = t["entry_time"].astimezone(NEW_YORK)
+        by_symbol[t["symbol"]].append(t)
+        by_month[local.strftime("%Y-%m")].append(t)
+        bucket = f"{local.hour:02d}:{(local.minute//30)*30:02d}"
+        by_tod[bucket].append(t)
+    summarize = lambda groups: {key: {"count": len(vals), "net_pnl": sum((x["pnl"] for x in vals), ZERO),
+                                       "win_rate": Decimal(sum(x["pnl"] > ZERO for x in vals))/len(vals)}
+                                for key, vals in sorted(groups.items())}
+    sample_ci = None
+    if n and bootstrap_samples > 0:
+        rng = random.Random(seed)
+        samples = sorted(sum((trades[rng.randrange(n)]["pnl"] for _ in range(n)), ZERO)/n
+                         for _ in range(bootstrap_samples))
+        sample_ci = (samples[int((bootstrap_samples-1)*Decimal("0.025"))],
+                     samples[int((bootstrap_samples-1)*Decimal("0.975"))])
+    warnings = (f"small sample: {n} closed trades; threshold is {small_sample_threshold}",) if n < small_sample_threshold else ()
+    excursions: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for t in trades:
+        holding = [b for b in bars if str(b["symbol"]).upper() == t["symbol"] and
+                   t["entry_time"] <= _dt(b["time"]) <= t["exit_time"]]
+        if holding:
+            high = max(_decimal(b["high"]) for b in holding)
+            low = min(_decimal(b["low"]) for b in holding)
+            t["mfe"] = max(ZERO, high-t["entry_price"])*t["quantity"]
+            t["mae"] = min(ZERO, low-t["entry_price"])*t["quantity"]
+        excursions.append({"symbol": t["symbol"], "entry_time": t["entry_time"], "mfe": t["mfe"], "mae": t["mae"]})
+    utilization = ZERO
+    if fills:
+        exposure: dict[str, Decimal] = defaultdict(lambda: ZERO)
+        marks: dict[str, Decimal] = {}
+        peak_exposure = ZERO
+        for f in sorted(fills, key=lambda row: _dt(row["time"])):
+            symbol = str(f["symbol"]).upper()
+            qty, price = _decimal(f["quantity"]), _decimal(f["price"])
+            marks[symbol] = price
+            exposure[symbol] += qty if str(f["side"]).upper() in ("BUY", "B") else -qty
+            peak_exposure = max(peak_exposure, sum((max(ZERO,q)*marks.get(s,ZERO) for s,q in exposure.items()),ZERO))

+        utilization = min(Decimal(1), peak_exposure/denom) if denom else ZERO
+    final_cash = cumulative if not equity else _decimal(equity[-1].get("cash", equity[-1].get("equity", cumulative)))
+    final_equity = cumulative if not equity else _decimal(equity[-1].get("equity", final_cash))
+    return BacktestMetrics(
+        total_return=gross_pnl/capital,
+        net_return=net_pnl/capital,
+        cash=final_cash,
+        equity_curve=equity,
+        trades=tuple(trades),
+        max_drawdown=max_dd,
+        profit_factor=None if gross_losses == ZERO else gross_wins/gross_losses,
+        win_rate=Decimal(len(wins))/n if n else ZERO,
+        average_win=sum(wins, ZERO)/len(wins) if wins else None,
+        average_loss=sum(losses, ZERO)/len(losses) if losses else None,
+        expectancy_net=expectancy,
+        mfe_mae=tuple(excursions), by_symbol=summarize(by_symbol), by_month=summarize(by_month),
+        by_time_of_day=summarize(by_tod), capital_utilization=utilization, sample_size=n,
+        expectancy_bootstrap_ci=sample_ci, warnings=warnings,
+    )

+class BacktestRunner:
+    """Run registered strategies over a supplied replay feed and simulator."""
+    def __init__(self, registry: StrategyRegistry, feed: HistoricalReplayFeed,
+                 clock: ReplayClock, execution: HistoricalExecutionSimulator,
+                 *, scheduler: StrategyScheduler | None = None,
+                 intent_factory: Callable[..., Any] | None = None,
+                 budget_policy: Any = None, eligibility_policy: Any = None,
+                 position_coordinator: Any = None, cycle_accounting: Any = None,
+                 protection_math: Any = None) -> None:
+        self.registry, self.feed, self.clock, self.execution = registry, feed, clock, execution
+        self.scheduler = scheduler or StrategyScheduler(clock)
+        self.intent_factory = intent_factory
+        self.policies = (budget_policy, eligibility_policy, position_coordinator, cycle_accounting, protection_math)
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _reject_real_broker(broker: object | None, execution: object) -> None:
+        for candidate in (broker, execution):
+            if candidate is None:
+                continue
+            module = type(candidate).__module__.lower()
+            name = type(candidate).__name__.lower()
+            environment = str(getattr(candidate, "environment", "")).lower()
+            if "alpaca" in module or "alpaca" in name or environment in {"paper", "live"}:
+                raise ValueError("real Alpaca/paper/live broker clients are refused in backtests")
+
+    async def run(self, request: BacktestRequest) -> BacktestResult:
+        self._reject_real_broker(request.broker, self.execution)
+        if self.feed.seed != request.seed:
+            raise ValueError("request seed must match the injected replay feed seed")
+        if getattr(self.execution, "_feed", self.feed) is not self.feed or getattr(
+            self.execution, "_clock", self.clock
+        ) is not self.clock:
+            raise ValueError("execution simulator must share the injected replay feed and clock")
+        def inspect_broker_config(value: Any, key: str = "") -> None:
+            if isinstance(value, Mapping):
+                for child_key, child_value in value.items():
+                    inspect_broker_config(child_value, str(child_key).lower())
+            elif key in {"broker", "broker_type", "provider", "environment", "mode"}:
+                if isinstance(value, str) and value.strip().lower() in {
+                    "alpaca", "alpaca_paper", "paper", "live", "alpaca_live"
+                }:
+                    raise ValueError("configuration resolves to a real Alpaca/paper/live broker")
+                if not isinstance(value, str):
+                    self._reject_real_broker(value, None)
+        inspect_broker_config(request.config)
+        role = PeriodRole(request.period_role)
+        provenance = self.feed.provenance
+        strategies = []
+        for strategy_id in request.strategy_ids:
+            cls = self.registry.get(strategy_id, request.strategy_versions.get(strategy_id))
+            strategies.append(cls)
+        for symbol in request.symbols:
+            self.scheduler.watch(symbol)
+            for cls in strategies:
+                self.scheduler.register(
+                    symbol=symbol, strategy_id=cls.spec.strategy_id, side=cls.spec.side,
+                    triggers=(StrategyTrigger(TriggerKind.CANDLE_CLOSED,
+                                               timeframe=cls.spec.trigger_timeframe),),
+                )
+        effective = dict(request.config)
+        assumptions = self.execution.assumptions
+        amap = dict(assumptions.as_mapping())
+        effective.update({"seed": request.seed, "strategy_ids": list(request.strategy_ids),
+                          "strategy_versions": {c.spec.strategy_id:c.spec.version for c in strategies},
+                          "strategy_params": request.strategy_params,
+                          "execution_assumptions": amap,
+                          "starting_capital": request.starting_capital,
+                          "symbols": sorted(request.symbols),
+                          "window_start": request.window_start,
+                          "window_end": request.window_end})
+        digest = config_hash(effective)
+        if role is PeriodRole.HOLDOUT:
+            lock = request.holdout_lock
+            if lock is None:
+                raise HoldoutViolationError("HOLDOUT requires an explicit holdout lock token")
+            if lock.research_config_hash != digest:
+                raise HoldoutViolationError("holdout config differs from locked research configuration")
+            if request.window_start.astimezone(UTC) < lock.window_start or request.window_end.astimezone(UTC) > lock.window_end:
+                raise HoldoutViolationError("HOLDOUT run must stay within locked holdout window")
+            access = {"token": lock.token, "accessed_at": self.clock.now()}
+        else:
+            access = None
+            lock = request.holdout_lock
+            if lock and request.window_start.astimezone(UTC) < lock.window_end and request.window_end.astimezone(UTC) > lock.window_start:
+                raise HoldoutViolationError("research/dev window overlaps locked holdout window")
+        dataset_hash = provenance.dataset_hash or ""
+        run_id = hashlib.sha256(canonical_json({"config_hash":digest,"dataset_hash":dataset_hash,
+                            "symbols":sorted(request.symbols),"start":request.window_start,
+                            "end":request.window_end,"role":role.value}).encode()).hexdigest()
+        manifest = RunManifest(run_id, request.window_start, digest, tuple(request.symbols),
+            request.window_start, request.window_end, role, code_revision(),
+            {"source":provenance.source,"feed":provenance.feed,"is_consolidated":provenance.is_consolidated,
+             "adjustment":provenance.adjustment,"point_in_time":provenance.point_in_time},
+            provenance.revision, provenance.revision, dataset_hash, str(request.starting_capital),
+            {k:v for k,v in amap.items() if k.startswith("fee_")},
+            {k:v for k,v in amap.items() if "slippage" in k},
+            {k:v for k,v in amap.items() if "fill" in k},
+            {k:v for k,v in amap.items() if "ambiguity" in k}, request.seed,
+            tuple({"name":c.spec.strategy_id,"version":c.spec.version} for c in strategies), access)
+        root = Path(request.result_directory)
+        write_manifest(manifest, root)
+        evaluations: list[Mapping[str, Any]] = []
+        signals: list[Mapping[str, Any]] = []
+        intents: list[Mapping[str, Any]] = []
+        fills: list[Mapping[str, Any]] = []
+        cycles: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+        equity_curve: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+        cash = request.starting_capital
+        quantities: dict[str, Decimal] = defaultdict(lambda: ZERO)
+        marks: dict[str, Decimal] = {}
+        open_cycles: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
+        candles_by_symbol: dict[str,list[Candle]] = defaultdict(list)
+        replay_events = [e for e in self.feed.events(symbols=request.symbols)
+                         if e.available_at and request.window_start <= e.available_at <= request.window_end]
+        trigger_rows: set[tuple[str,str,datetime]] = set()
+        state: dict[tuple[str,str],dict[str,Any]] = defaultdict(dict)
+        params = {sid: self.registry.validate_parameters(sid, request.strategy_params.get(sid, {}), request.strategy_versions.get(sid)) for sid in request.strategy_ids}
+        for ev in replay_events:
+            assert ev.available_at
+            self.clock.advance_to(ev.available_at)
+            outputs = self.execution.process_event(ev)
+            for x in outputs:
+                fill_row={"symbol":x.symbol,"side":x.side.value,"quantity":x.quantity,"price":x.price,
+                          "fee":x.fee,"time":x.fill.filled_at,"order_id":x.fill.broker_order_id,
+                          "evidence":x.evidence}
+                fills.append(fill_row)
+                signed = x.quantity if x.side.value == "BUY" else -x.quantity
+                cash += -(x.quantity*x.price+x.fee) if x.side.value == "BUY" else x.quantity*x.price-x.fee
+                quantities[x.symbol] += signed
+                marks[x.symbol] = x.price
+                if x.side.value == "BUY":
+                    if x.symbol not in open_cycles:
+                        open_cycles[x.symbol]={"cycle_id":f"{run_id}:{x.symbol}:{len(cycles)+1}",
+                                               "symbol":x.symbol,"opened_at":x.fill.filled_at,
+                                               "closed_at":None,"entry_quantity":ZERO,"exit_quantity":ZERO}
+                    open_cycles[x.symbol]["entry_quantity"] += x.quantity
+                elif x.symbol in open_cycles:
+                    open_cycles[x.symbol]["exit_quantity"] += x.quantity
+                    if quantities[x.symbol] <= ZERO:
+                        cycle=open_cycles.pop(x.symbol)
+                        cycle["closed_at"]=x.fill.filled_at
+                        cycles.append(cycle)
+                equity_curve.append({"time":x.fill.filled_at,"cash":cash,
+                    "equity":cash+sum((qty*marks.get(sym,ZERO) for sym,qty in quantities.items()),ZERO)})
+            if ev.kind != ReplayEvent.KIND_BAR or ev.candle is None:
+                continue
+            marks[ev.symbol]=ev.candle.close
+            equity_curve.append({"time":ev.available_at,"cash":cash,
+                "equity":cash+sum((qty*marks.get(sym,ZERO) for sym,qty in quantities.items()),ZERO)})
+            candles_by_symbol[ev.symbol].append(ev.candle)
+            due = self.scheduler.process(CandleClosedEvent(ev.symbol, CandleTimeframe(ev.candle.timeframe.value), ev.candle.end,
+                                                           snapshot_version=len(candles_by_symbol[ev.symbol]), due_at=ev.available_at))
+            due_ids = {(item.symbol, item.strategy_id) for item in due}
+            # Registry class specs drive closed-bar trigger cadence and evaluation.
+            for cls in strategies:
+                spec = cls.spec
+                if (ev.symbol, spec.strategy_id) not in due_ids:
+                    continue
+                if ev.candle.timeframe.value != spec.trigger_timeframe.value or len(candles_by_symbol[ev.symbol]) < max(1,spec.warmup_bars):
+                    continue
+                key=(ev.symbol,spec.strategy_id,ev.candle.start)

+                trigger_rows.add(key)
+                history=tuple(candles_by_symbol[ev.symbol][-max(spec.warmup_bars+1,1):])
+                spec_tf=CandleTimeframe(spec.trigger_timeframe.value)
+                converted=tuple(StrategyCandle(c.symbol,spec_tf,c.start,c.end,c.open,c.high,c.low,c.close,

+                    PriceBasis.RAW,CandleStatus.CLOSED,c.trade_count) for c in history)
+                session_status=self.clock.session_status()
+                age=ev.available_at-ev.candle.end
+                freshness=ContextFreshness(ev.candle.end,max(age, timedelta(0)), timedelta(minutes=5),False,None)
+                context=MarketContext(ev.symbol,ev.available_at,len(candles_by_symbol[ev.symbol]),

+                    ev.available_at.astimezone(NEW_YORK).date().isoformat(),freshness,
+                    {spec_tf:converted},{})
+                strategy=cls()
+                evaluation: StrategyEvaluation=strategy.evaluate(context,params[spec.strategy_id],state[(ev.symbol,spec.strategy_id)])

+def _event(minute: int, price: str = "100") -> ReplayEvent:
+    start = UTC0 + minute * MIN
+    px = D(price)
+    return ReplayEvent.bar(Candle("AAA", Timeframe.M1, start, start+MIN,
+        px, px, px, px, D("1000"), FEED_PROV))

+def _runner(seed: int = 7):

+    feed = HistoricalReplayFeed([_event(0), _event(1)], PROV, clock=clock, seed=seed)
+    execution = HistoricalExecutionSimulator(feed, clock, ExecutionAssumptions())
+    return clock, feed, execution

+"""Immutable, content-addressed backtest run manifests.
+
+Manifests and run results are stored in run-scoped files by :mod:`runner`; the
+existing SQLite schema is deliberately unchanged for this task.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+import subprocess
+from dataclasses import dataclass, fields, is_dataclass
+from datetime import UTC, datetime
+from decimal import Decimal
+from enum import StrEnum
+from pathlib import Path
+from types import MappingProxyType
+from typing import Any, Mapping
+
+
+class PeriodRole(StrEnum):
+    RESEARCH = "RESEARCH"
+    DEV = "DEV"
+    HOLDOUT = "HOLDOUT"
+
+
+class HoldoutViolationError(ValueError):
+    """A holdout access or retuning rule was violated."""
+
+
+def canonical_json(value: Any) -> str:
+    """Canonical JSON for manifest/config/result hashing; rejects floats."""
+    def normalize(item: Any) -> Any:
+        if isinstance(item, datetime):
+            if item.tzinfo is None or item.utcoffset() is None:
+                raise ValueError("datetimes must be timezone-aware")
+            return item.astimezone(UTC).isoformat(timespec="microseconds").replace("+00:00", "Z")
+        if hasattr(item, "value") and isinstance(item.value, (str, int)):
+            return item.value
+        if isinstance(item, float):
+            raise TypeError("floats are not allowed in canonical backtest values")
+        if isinstance(item, Mapping):
+            return {str(k): normalize(v) for k, v in item.items()}
+        if isinstance(item, (list, tuple)):
+            return [normalize(v) for v in item]
+        if isinstance(item, (str, int, bool)) or item is None:
+            return item
+        if hasattr(item, "as_mapping"):
+            return normalize(item.as_mapping())
+        if isinstance(item, Decimal):
+            if not item.is_finite():
+                raise ValueError("non-finite Decimal is not canonical")
+            return format(item, "f")
+        if is_dataclass(item):
+            return normalize({field.name: getattr(item, field.name) for field in fields(item)})
+        raise TypeError(f"unsupported canonical value {type(item).__name__}")
+
+    return json.dumps(normalize(value), sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=True)
+
+
+def config_hash(config: Mapping[str, Any]) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(canonical_json(config).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
+
+
+def code_revision(cwd: str | Path | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Capture local git commit and dirty status without network access."""
+    try:
+        commit = subprocess.run(
+            ["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], cwd=cwd, check=True, capture_output=True,
+            text=True, timeout=2,
+        ).stdout.strip()
+        dirty = bool(subprocess.run(
+            ["git", "status", "--porcelain"], cwd=cwd, check=True, capture_output=True,
+            text=True, timeout=2,
+        ).stdout.strip())
+    except (OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError):
+        commit, dirty = "unknown", False
+    return {"commit": commit, "dirty": dirty}
+

+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class HoldoutLock:

+    created_at: datetime
+    config_hash: str

+    window_end: datetime

+    ambiguity_assumptions: Mapping[str, Any]

+    strategies: tuple[Mapping[str, str], ...]

+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        if not self.run_id or not self.config_hash:
+            raise ValueError("run_id and config_hash are required")
+        if not isinstance(self.period_role, PeriodRole):
+            object.__setattr__(self, "period_role", PeriodRole(self.period_role))
+        for name in ("created_at", "window_start", "window_end"):
+            dt = getattr(self, name)
+            if dt.tzinfo is None or dt.utcoffset() is None:
+                raise ValueError(f"{name} must be timezone-aware")
+            object.__setattr__(self, name, dt.astimezone(UTC))
+        if self.window_end <= self.window_start:
+            raise ValueError("window must be bounded and non-empty")
+        if not 1 <= len(self.symbols) <= 10:
+            raise ValueError("manifest requires 1-10 symbols")
+        object.__setattr__(self, "symbols", tuple(sorted({s.upper() for s in self.symbols})))
+        for name in ("code_revision", "data_provenance", "fee_assumptions", "slippage_assumptions",
+                     "fill_assumptions", "ambiguity_assumptions", "holdout_access"):
+            value = getattr(self, name)
+            if value is not None:
+                object.__setattr__(self, name, MappingProxyType(dict(value)))
+        object.__setattr__(self, "strategies", tuple(MappingProxyType(dict(v)) for v in self.strategies))
+        if isinstance(self.seed, bool) or not isinstance(self.seed, int):
+            raise ValueError("seed must be int")
+
+    def canonical(self) -> str:
+        return canonical_json({field.name: getattr(self, field.name) for field in fields(self)})
+
+    @property
+    def content_hash(self) -> str:
+        return hashlib.sha256(self.canonical().encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
+
+    @classmethod
+    def from_json(cls, value: str) -> "RunManifest":
+        raw = json.loads(value)
+        for field in ("created_at", "window_start", "window_end"):
+            raw[field] = datetime.fromisoformat(raw[field].replace("Z", "+00:00"))
+        raw["period_role"] = PeriodRole(raw["period_role"])
+        raw["symbols"] = tuple(raw["symbols"])
+        raw["strategies"] = tuple(raw["strategies"])
+        return cls(**raw)
+
+
+def write_manifest(manifest: RunManifest, directory: str | Path) -> Path:
+    """Create once; exclusive creation rejects any existing run id."""
+    target = Path(directory) / f"{manifest.run_id}.manifest.json"
+    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    payload = manifest.canonical()
+    with target.open("x", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as stream:
+        stream.write(payload)
+        stream.flush()
+        os.fsync(stream.fileno())
+    return target

+def _decimal(value: Any) -> Decimal:
+    if isinstance(value, Decimal):
+        return value
+    if isinstance(value, str):
+        return Decimal(value)
+    raise TypeError("metric money, quantities and prices must be Decimal or decimal strings")
+
+
+def _dt(value: Any) -> datetime:
+    return value if isinstance(value, datetime) else datetime.fromisoformat(str(value).replace("Z", "+00:00"))
+
+
+def _trade_records(fills: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    """Pair long entries/exits FIFO, preserving costs and timestamps."""
+    queues: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(list)
+    trades: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    ordered = sorted(fills, key=lambda f: _dt(f["time"]))
+    for fill in ordered:
+        symbol = str(fill["symbol"]).upper()
+        side = str(fill["side"]).upper()
+        qty, price, fee = _decimal(fill["quantity"]), _decimal(fill["price"]), _decimal(fill.get("fee", "0"))
+        at = _dt(fill["time"])
+        if side in ("BUY", "B"):
+            queues[symbol].append({"qty": qty, "price": price, "fee": fee, "time": at,
+                                   "high": _decimal(fill.get("high", price)), "low": _decimal(fill.get("low", price)),
+                                   "entry_time": at})
+            continue
+        if side not in ("SELL", "S"):
+            continue
+        remaining = qty
+        while remaining > ZERO and queues[symbol]:
+            lot = queues[symbol][0]
+            matched = min(remaining, lot["qty"])
+            fraction = matched / qty
+            entry_fee = lot["fee"] * (matched / (matched + lot["qty"] - matched)) if lot["qty"] else ZERO
+            exit_fee = fee * fraction
+            gross = (price - lot["price"]) * matched
+            pnl = gross - entry_fee - exit_fee
+            trades.append({"symbol": symbol, "entry_time": lot["time"], "exit_time": at,
+                           "entry_price": lot["price"], "exit_price": price, "quantity": matched,
+                           "gross_pnl": gross, "costs": entry_fee + exit_fee, "pnl": pnl,
+                           "hold_duration_seconds": Decimal(str((at-lot["time"]).total_seconds())),
+                           "mfe": (lot["high"]-lot["price"]) * matched,
+                           "mae": (lot["low"]-lot["price"]) * matched})
+            lot["qty"] -= matched
+            remaining -= matched
+            if lot["qty"] == ZERO:
+                queues[symbol].pop(0)
+    return trades
+
+
+def compute_metrics(
+    results: BacktestResult | Mapping[str, Any] | Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]],
+    *, starting_capital: Decimal,
+    seed: int = 0,
+    bootstrap_samples: int = 2000,
+    small_sample_threshold: int = 30,
+    bars: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]] = (),
+) -> BacktestMetrics:
+    """Compute descriptive, cost-aware statistics from persisted fills/results."""
+    if isinstance(results, BacktestResult):
+        fills = results.fills
+        curve = results.equity_curve
+    elif isinstance(results, Mapping):
+        fills = results.get("fills", ())
+        curve = results.get("equity_curve", ())
+    else:
+        fills = results
+        curve = ()
+    capital = _decimal(starting_capital)
+    if fills and all("pnl" in row for row in fills):
+        trades = []
+        for row in fills:
+            item = dict(row)
+            item["pnl"] = _decimal(item["pnl"])
+            item["gross_pnl"] = _decimal(item.get("gross_pnl", item["pnl"]))
+            item["costs"] = _decimal(item.get("costs", item["gross_pnl"]-item["pnl"]))
+            item["symbol"] = str(item.get("symbol", "UNKNOWN")).upper()
+            item["entry_time"] = _dt(item["entry_time"])
+            item["exit_time"] = _dt(item["exit_time"])
+            item["quantity"] = _decimal(item.get("quantity", "0"))
+            item["entry_price"] = _decimal(item.get("entry_price", "0"))
+            item.setdefault("hold_duration_seconds", Decimal(str((item["exit_time"]-item["entry_time"]).total_seconds())))
+            item["mfe"] = _decimal(item.get("mfe", "0"))
+            item["mae"] = _decimal(item.get("mae", "0"))
+            trades.append(item)
+    else:
+        trades = _trade_records(fills)
+    cumulative = capital
+    generated_curve: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    peak = capital
+    max_dd = ZERO
+    for trade in trades:
+        cumulative += trade["pnl"]
+        peak = max(peak, cumulative)
+        if peak:
+            max_dd = max(max_dd, (peak-cumulative)/peak)
+        generated_curve.append({"time": trade["exit_time"], "cash": cumulative, "equity": cumulative})
+    equity = tuple(curve) if curve else tuple(generated_curve)
+    net_pnl = sum((t["pnl"] for t in trades), ZERO)
+    gross_pnl = sum((t["gross_pnl"] for t in trades), ZERO)
+    gross_wins = sum((t["pnl"] for t in trades if t["pnl"] > ZERO), ZERO)
+    gross_losses = -sum((t["pnl"] for t in trades if t["pnl"] < ZERO), ZERO)
+    wins = [t["pnl"] for t in trades if t["pnl"] > ZERO]
+    losses = [t["pnl"] for t in trades if t["pnl"] < ZERO]
+    n = len(trades)
+    expectancy = net_pnl / n if n else ZERO
+    by_symbol: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(list)

+    by_tod: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(list)

+        by_tod[bucket].append(t)
+    summarize = lambda groups: {key: {"count": len(vals), "net_pnl": sum((x["pnl"] for x in vals), ZERO),
+                                       "win_rate": Decimal(sum(x["pnl"] > ZERO for x in vals))/len(vals)}
+                                for key, vals in sorted(groups.items())}
+    sample_ci = None
+    if n and bootstrap_samples > 0:

+                     samples[int((bootstrap_samples-1)*Decimal("0.975"))])
+    warnings = (f"small sample: {n} closed trades; threshold is {small_sample_threshold}",) if n < small_sample_threshold else ()
+    excursions: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

+    return BacktestMetrics(

+class BacktestRunner:
+    """Run registered strategies over a supplied replay feed and simulator."""
+    def __init__(self, registry: StrategyRegistry, feed: HistoricalReplayFeed,

+    px = D(price)

## Purpose

All agents must follow these rules when modifying the codebase.

---

## Core Principles

- Minimal blast radius: only modify what is required for the task
- Deterministic verification: all changes must be verifiable via code (tests, compile, scripts)
- No architecture drift: do not introduce new frameworks or major design changes unless explicitly required
- No unrelated refactors

- docs/ → design, plans, architecture constraints
- plans/ → master plans
- phases/ → phase definitions
- tasks/ → executable task documents
- backends/ → CLI backend adapters
- agents/ → specialist agents
- runtime/ → orchestration, routing, state
- reports/ → execution reports (DO NOT MODIFY MANUALLY)

## Task Execution Rules

- Always operate from a task document when available
- Respect:
  - selected_backend
  - verification_profile
  - acceptance_criteria
- If a task conflicts with architecture constraints or phase scope:
  - STOP and report conflict

---

## Backend Rules

- Backends must:
  - execute commands deterministically
  - capture stdout, stderr, exit_code
  - not silently fail
- Do not invent backend interfaces; use existing adapters
- Codex CLI, Aider, Gemini, Claude Code should be invoked through backends only

---

## Verification Rules

- Verification must be deterministic
- Preferred checks:
  - pytest
  - python -m py_compile
- Do not rely on model self-evaluation

---

## Execution Control Flow (PERMANENT ARCHITECTURAL RULE)

**HEURISTIC INFERENCE MUST NEVER PARTICIPATE IN ABRACAPOCUS EXECUTION CONTROL FLOW.**

Abracapocus must not determine execution success, failure, acceptance,
rejection, blocking, retry eligibility, phase progression, or completion from
heuristic inference. A heuristic is any conclusion that is *inferred* rather
than *directly established by an explicit executable contract or a concrete
runtime fact*.

Runtime status is derived ONLY from concrete, mechanically observable facts:

1. The backend process exit code. A backend that exits `0` (with no hard
   write-policy violation) is a successful execution.
2. Objectively observed hard write-policy violations (changed paths outside the
   declared allowed write paths).
3. Explicit operator-authored commands (task/phase verification the plan
   explicitly contains). Their raw results are reported, kept DISTINCT from
   backend execution status.
4. Objective orchestrator failures with direct evidence (backend could not
   launch, required document could not be parsed, subprocess infrastructure
   failed).

**Verification results are observational and must not rewrite backend execution
status.** A verifier returning non-zero must NEVER, by itself, turn a
successful backend execution into unverified, stop a phase, or trigger an
automatic rerun. Verification is the result of a command, not authority to
rewrite history.

**Execution control:** Task-local problems (non-zero exit, timeout,
write-policy violation, frame failure, backend launch failure) produce
acceptance status ``"unverified"`` with truthful evidence preserved. They
MUST NOT stop sibling tasks, later phases, or the plan. Only operator
cancellation (SIGINT/SIGTERM/dashboard cancel) may terminate a run
(acceptance status ``"interrupted"``). Dependencies are ordering constraints,
not acceptance gates — any terminal attempt outcome satisfies a dependency
edge. The status ``"failed"`` is banned from acceptance output.

Do NOT reintroduce -- under any name, feature flag, "advisory" wrapper, or
compatibility mode -- context completeness/sufficiency scoring, change or
architecture assessment used as a gate, intent/scope matching, reconciliation
gates, no-progress judgments, confidence/risk scores, model/LLM/reviewer
judgments over status, shadow/adaptive/secondary-verification gates, or
heuristic retry/failure-classification control flow. Failure classification may
only *summarize* an already-established concrete failure; it must never create
one. Retries are permitted only for explicitly defined mechanical backend
failures. Future agents must not add these systems back.

---

  - runtime_state.json
  - reports/
  - logs/
  - virtual environments

## Forbidden Changes

- Modifying unrelated files
- Deleting important files

## Planning Rules

- Plans are multi-phase

  - active phase

---

## Reporting

- Reports must include:
  - changed files
  - verification results
  - assessment

---

## Behavior

- Do not ask unnecessary questions
- Do not stall execution
- Do not perform broad scans unless required
- Prefer direct action over analysis

## Priority Order

This ordering guides *implementation decisions* only. It does NOT make
verification an acceptance authority: verification results are observational
(see "Execution Control Flow"), and never override a concrete backend
execution result.

1. Architecture constraints
2. Task definition
3. Verification results (observational signal, not acceptance authority)
4. Plan guidance

If conflicts occur, follow this order.

Strategy classes are registered by the composition root with a plain call
(``registry.register(MyBuyStrategy)``) after importing them normally.  There is

StrategyClass = type[BuyStrategy] | type[SellStrategy]

_SIDE_BASES: dict[StrategyRole, StrategyClass] = {
    StrategyRole.BUY: BuyStrategy,
    StrategyRole.SELL: SellStrategy,
}


class StrategyRegistryError(MikeTradeError):
    """Registration or lookup failed.

    ``code`` is one of ``duplicate_registration``, ``invalid_strategy`` or
    ``not_found``.
    """


class StrategyRegistry:
    """Maps ``(strategy_id, version)`` to a registered strategy class."""

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._entries: dict[tuple[str, str], StrategyClass] = {}

    def register(self, strategy_cls: StrategyClass) -> StrategyClass:
        """Register a concrete ``BuyStrategy``/``SellStrategy`` subclass.

        Raises ``StrategyRegistryError`` for an invalid class or a duplicate
        ``(strategy_id, version)``.  Returns the class unchanged.
        """
        if not inspect.isclass(strategy_cls) or not issubclass(
            strategy_cls, (BuyStrategy, SellStrategy)
        ):
            raise StrategyRegistryError(
                f"{strategy_cls!r} is not a BuyStrategy or SellStrategy subclass",
                code="invalid_strategy",
            )
        if inspect.isabstract(strategy_cls):
            raise StrategyRegistryError(
                f"{strategy_cls.__name__} is abstract and cannot be registered",
                code="invalid_strategy",
            )
        spec = getattr(strategy_cls, "spec", None)
        if not isinstance(spec, StrategySpec):
            raise StrategyRegistryError(
                f"{strategy_cls.__name__} must define a StrategySpec as `spec`",
                code="invalid_strategy",
            )
        if not issubclass(strategy_cls, _SIDE_BASES[spec.side]):
            raise StrategyRegistryError(
                f"{strategy_cls.__name__} spec side {spec.side.value} does not match its base",
                code="invalid_strategy",
            )
        key = (spec.strategy_id, spec.version)
        if key in self._entries:
            raise StrategyRegistryError(
                f"strategy {spec.strategy_id} {spec.version} is already registered",
                code="duplicate_registration",
                context={"strategy_id": spec.strategy_id, "version": spec.version},
            )
        self._entries[key] = strategy_cls
        return strategy_cls

    def get(self, strategy_id: str, version: str | None = None) -> StrategyClass:
        """Return the pinned ``version``, or the highest semantic version if omitted."""
        if version is not None:
            try:
                return self._entries[(strategy_id, version)]
            except KeyError:
                raise StrategyRegistryError(
                    f"strategy {strategy_id} {version} is not registered",
                    code="not_found",
                    context={"strategy_id": strategy_id, "version": version},
                ) from None
        candidates = [cls for (sid, _), cls in self._entries.items() if sid == strategy_id]
        if not candidates:
            raise StrategyRegistryError(
                f"strategy {strategy_id} is not registered",
                code="not_found",
                context={"strategy_id": strategy_id},
            )
        return max(candidates, key=lambda cls: cls.spec.version_key)

    def list_strategies(self, side: StrategyRole | None = None) -> tuple[StrategyClass, ...]:
        """Return registered classes, optionally for one side, ordered by id then version."""
        if side is not None and not isinstance(side, StrategyRole):
            raise ValueError(f"side must be StrategyRole or None; got {type(side).__name__}")
        selected = [cls for cls in self._entries.values() if side is None or cls.spec.side is side]
        return tuple(sorted(selected, key=lambda cls: (cls.spec.strategy_id, cls.spec.version_key)))

    def validate_parameters(
        self, strategy_id: str, params: Mapping[str, object], version: str | None = None
    ) -> Mapping[str, object]:
        """Validate ``params`` against the strategy spec's schema (delegated)."""
        return self.get(strategy_id, version).spec.parameter_schema.validate(params)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------- validation


def _utc(value: object, field: str) -> datetime:
    if not isinstance(value, datetime):
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a datetime; got {type(value).__name__}")
    if value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be timezone-aware")
    return value.astimezone(UTC)


def _opt_utc(value: object, field: str) -> datetime | None:
    return None if value is None else _utc(value, field)


def _symbol(value: object, field: str = "symbol") -> str:
    if not isinstance(value, str):
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be str; got {type(value).__name__}")
    text = value.strip().upper()
    if _SYMBOL_RE.fullmatch(text) is None:
        raise ValueError(f"{field} is invalid: {value!r}")
    return text


def _text(value: object, field: str) -> str:
    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a non-empty str")
    return value.strip()


def _decimal(value: object, field: str) -> Decimal:
    if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, Decimal):
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be Decimal; got {type(value).__name__}")
    if not value.is_finite():
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be finite")
    return value

@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class DataProvenance:
    """Explicit origin of a replay dataset.

    ``feed`` is the exchange feed (e.g. ``"IEX"``; ``is_consolidated=False`` so
    it is never mistaken for SIP), ``revision`` the dataset revision/vintage
    label, ``adjustment`` one of RAW / SPLIT_ADJUSTED / TOTAL_RETURN_ADJUSTED,
    and ``point_in_time`` whether adjusted/revised values are vintage-correct.
    ``dataset_hash`` is the SHA-256 of the supplied records; ``None`` lets the
    feed fill it in, a value is verified.

    source: str
    feed: str
    is_consolidated: bool
    revision: str
    adjustment: str = "RAW"
    point_in_time: bool = False
    quote_fidelity: QuoteFidelity = QuoteFidelity.SAMPLED
    dataset_hash: str | None = None

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        for name in ("source", "feed", "revision"):
            object.__setattr__(self, name, _text(getattr(self, name), name))
        if not isinstance(self.is_consolidated, bool) or not isinstance(self.point_in_time, bool):
            raise ValueError("is_consolidated and point_in_time must be bool")
        adjustment = _text(self.adjustment, "adjustment").upper()
        if adjustment not in _ADJUSTMENTS:
            raise ValueError(
                f"adjustment must be one of {sorted(_ADJUSTMENTS)}; got {adjustment!r}"
            )
        object.__setattr__(self, "adjustment", adjustment)
        if not isinstance(self.quote_fidelity, QuoteFidelity):
            raise ValueError("quote_fidelity must be QuoteFidelity")
        if self.dataset_hash is not None and (
            not isinstance(self.dataset_hash, str) or _HASH_RE.fullmatch(self.dataset_hash) is None
        ):
            raise ValueError("dataset_hash must be a lowercase sha256 hex digest or None")

    def feed_provenance(self) -> FeedProvenance:
        """Domain-level provenance carried by emitted candles/events."""
        return FeedProvenance(
            provider="replay",
            feed=self.feed,
            source=self.source,
            is_consolidated=self.is_consolidated,

        object.__setattr__(self, "symbol", _symbol(self.symbol))

"""Deterministic NYSE session calendar.

The calendar is rule based and intentionally performs no I/O. Session dates are
interpreted in New York time; all public instant values are returned in UTC.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import UTC, date, datetime, time, timedelta
from enum import Enum
from types import MappingProxyType
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo

NEW_YORK = ZoneInfo("America/New_York")
SUPPORTED_YEAR_START = 2000
SUPPORTED_YEAR_END = 2035


class SessionStatus(str, Enum):
    PRE_OPEN = "PRE_OPEN"
    REGULAR = "REGULAR"
    CLOSED = "CLOSED"
    HOLIDAY = "HOLIDAY"
    UNKNOWN = "UNKNOWN"


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Session:
    """An immutable regular NYSE session, including its effective close."""

    session_id: str
    session_date: date
    open_et: datetime
    close_et: datetime
    is_early_close: bool
    open_utc: datetime
    close_utc: datetime


# Override entries augment the published rule calendar.  Values are either
# ``"closed"`` or an early close time expressed as an ET wall-clock time.
SPECIAL_OVERRIDES: MappingProxyType[date, str | time] = MappingProxyType(
    {
        date(2025, 1, 9): "closed",  # National day of mourning for President Carter.
    }
)


def _check_year(day: date) -> None:
    if not SUPPORTED_YEAR_START <= day.year <= SUPPORTED_YEAR_END:
        raise ValueError(
            f"date year {day.year} is outside supported range "
            f"{SUPPORTED_YEAR_START}-{SUPPORTED_YEAR_END}"
        )


def _observed_fixed(day: date, *, new_year: bool = False) -> date | None:
    """Return a fixed-date holiday's observed date under NYSE rules."""
    if day.weekday() == 5:
        return None if new_year else day - timedelta(days=1)
    if day.weekday() == 6:
        return day + timedelta(days=1)
    return day


def _easter_sunday(year: int) -> date:
    """Gregorian Easter computus (Meeus/Jones/Butcher)."""
    a = year % 19
    b, c = divmod(year, 100)
    d, e = divmod(b, 4)
    f = (b + 8) // 25
    g = (b - f + 1) // 3
    h = (19 * a + b - d - g + 15) % 30
    i, k = divmod(c, 4)
    l = (32 + 2 * e + 2 * i - h - k) % 7
    m = (a + 11 * h + 22 * l) // 451
    month, day_num = divmod(h + l - 7 * m + 114, 31)
    return date(year, month, day_num + 1)


def _nth_weekday(year: int, month: int, weekday: int, n: int) -> date:
    first = date(year, month, 1)
    return first + timedelta(days=(weekday - first.weekday()) % 7 + 7 * (n - 1))


def _last_weekday(year: int, month: int, weekday: int) -> date:
    last_day = date(year + (month == 12), month % 12 + 1, 1) - timedelta(days=1)
    return last_day - timedelta(days=(last_day.weekday() - weekday) % 7)


def _holidays(year: int) -> frozenset[date]:
    holidays: set[date] = {
        _nth_weekday(year, 1, 0, 3),  # Martin Luther King Jr. Day
        _nth_weekday(year, 2, 0, 3),  # Washington's Birthday
        _last_weekday(year, 5, 0),  # Memorial Day
        _easter_sunday(year) - timedelta(days=2),  # Good Friday
        _nth_weekday(year, 9, 0, 1),  # Labor Day
        _nth_weekday(year, 11, 3, 4),  # Thanksgiving
    }
    for month, day_num, is_new_year in (
        (1, 1, True),
        (7, 4, False),
        (12, 25, False),
    ):
        observed = _observed_fixed(date(year, month, day_num), new_year=is_new_year)
        if observed is not None:
            holidays.add(observed)
    if year >= 2022:
        observed = _observed_fixed(date(year, 6, 19))
        if observed is not None:
            holidays.add(observed)
    return frozenset(holidays)


def _is_trading_day_unchecked(day: date) -> bool:
    if day.weekday() >= 5:
        return False
    if day in _holidays(day.year):
        return False
    return SPECIAL_OVERRIDES.get(day) != "closed"


def is_trading_day(day: date) -> bool:
    """Return whether *day* has a regular NYSE session; unknown years raise."""
    if not isinstance(day, date) or isinstance(day, datetime):
        raise TypeError("day must be a datetime.date")
    _check_year(day)
    return _is_trading_day_unchecked(day)


def session_for(day: date) -> Session:
    """Return the regular session for a trading date."""
    if not is_trading_day(day):
        raise ValueError(f"{day.isoformat()} is not a trading day")
    close_time = time(16, 0)
    early = False
    override = SPECIAL_OVERRIDES.get(day)
    if isinstance(override, time):
        close_time, early = override, True
    else:
        thanksgiving = _nth_weekday(day.year, 11, 3, 4)
        july_fourth = date(day.year, 7, 4)
        if day == thanksgiving + timedelta(days=1):
            close_time, early = time(13, 0), True
        elif day == date(day.year, 12, 24):
            close_time, early = time(13, 0), True
        elif (
            day == date(day.year, 7, 3)
            and july_fourth.weekday() in (1, 2, 3, 4)
        ):
            close_time, early = time(13, 0), True
    open_et = datetime.combine(day, time(9, 30), NEW_YORK)
    close_et = datetime.combine(day, close_time, NEW_YORK)
    return Session(
        session_id=f"XNYS-{day.isoformat()}",
        session_date=day,
        open_et=open_et,
        close_et=close_et,
        is_early_close=early,
        open_utc=open_et.astimezone(UTC),
        close_utc=close_et.astimezone(UTC),
    )


def _normalize_utc(at: datetime) -> datetime:
    if not isinstance(at, datetime) or at.tzinfo is None or at.utcoffset() is None:
        raise ValueError("at_utc must be a timezone-aware datetime")
    return at.astimezone(UTC)


def session_status(at_utc: datetime) -> SessionStatus:
    """Classify an instant; out-of-range dates are always UNKNOWN."""
    instant = _normalize_utc(at_utc)
    local_day = instant.astimezone(NEW_YORK).date()
    if not SUPPORTED_YEAR_START <= local_day.year <= SUPPORTED_YEAR_END:
        return SessionStatus.UNKNOWN
    if not _is_trading_day_unchecked(local_day):
        return SessionStatus.HOLIDAY if local_day.weekday() < 5 else SessionStatus.CLOSED
    session = session_for(local_day)
    if instant < session.open_utc:
        return SessionStatus.PRE_OPEN
    if instant < session.close_utc:
        return SessionStatus.REGULAR
    return SessionStatus.CLOSED


def is_regular_hours(at_utc: datetime) -> bool:
    return session_status(at_utc) is SessionStatus.REGULAR


def entry_cutoff(session: Session, minutes_before_close: int) -> datetime:
    """Return the UTC instant at which new entries stop for this session."""
    if not isinstance(session, Session):
        raise TypeError("session must be a Session")
    if isinstance(minutes_before_close, bool) or not isinstance(minutes_before_close, int):
        raise TypeError("minutes_before_close must be an integer")
    if minutes_before_close < 0:
        raise ValueError("minutes_before_close must be non-negative")
    return session.close_utc - timedelta(minutes=minutes_before_close)


def entries_allowed_by_time(at_utc: datetime, cutoff_minutes: int) -> bool:
    """Return whether entries are allowed at this instant before the close cutoff."""
    instant = _normalize_utc(at_utc)
    if session_status(instant) is not SessionStatus.REGULAR:
        return False
    session = session_for(instant.astimezone(NEW_YORK).date())
    return instant < entry_cutoff(session, cutoff_minutes)


def next_session(after: date) -> Session:
    """Return the first session strictly after *after*."""
    if not isinstance(after, date) or isinstance(after, datetime):
        raise TypeError("after must be a datetime.date")
    _check_year(after)
    day = after + timedelta(days=1)
    while day.year <= SUPPORTED_YEAR_END:
        if _is_trading_day_unchecked(day):
            return session_for(day)
        day += timedelta(days=1)
    raise ValueError("no next session within supported year range")


def previous_session(before: date) -> Session:
    """Return the last session strictly before *before*."""
    if not isinstance(before, date) or isinstance(before, datetime):
        raise TypeError("before must be a datetime.date")
    _check_year(before)
    day = before - timedelta(days=1)
    while day.year >= SUPPORTED_YEAR_START:
        if _is_trading_day_unchecked(day):
            return session_for(day)
        day -= timedelta(days=1)
    raise ValueError("no previous session within supported year range")


__all__ = [
    "NEW_YORK",
    "SUPPORTED_YEAR_START",
    "SUPPORTED_YEAR_END",
    "SPECIAL_OVERRIDES",
    "Session",
    "SessionStatus",
    "is_trading_day",
    "session_for",
    "session_status",
    "next_session",
    "previous_session",
    "is_regular_hours",
    "entry_cutoff",
    "entries_allowed_by_time",
]

"""Simulated replay clock for the historical replay/backtest subsystem.

``ReplayClock`` conforms to the application's ``mike_trade.runtime.ClockPort``
(``now() -> aware UTC datetime``), so engine/scheduler/strategy code reads time
only through it.  It never reads the wall clock and never sleeps: time moves
only when the replay event loop calls :meth:`ReplayClock.advance_to`, and only
forward.  Naive datetimes and backwards moves raise ``ValueError``.

Design choices (2):
1. Session presentation is a thin adapter over the existing module-level
   NYSE calendar in ``mike_trade.scheduling.calendar`` (open/close, early
   closes, holidays/no-session days, boundaries); no calendar rules are
   duplicated here and the calendar is not modified.  Dates outside the
   calendar's supported years yield ``SessionStatus.UNKNOWN`` / ``None``.
2. Moving to the current instant is a no-op (several events may share one
   timestamp); only a strictly earlier instant is a regression.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import UTC, date, datetime, timedelta

from mike_trade.scheduling import calendar as _nyse
from mike_trade.scheduling.calendar import NEW_YORK, Session, SessionStatus

__all__ = ["ReplayClock"]


def _require_aware(value: object, field: str) -> datetime:
    if not isinstance(value, datetime):
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a datetime; got {type(value).__name__}")
    if value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be timezone-aware")
    return value.astimezone(UTC)


class ReplayClock:
    """Monotonic, explicitly advanced, timezone-aware UTC simulated clock."""

    def __init__(self, start: datetime) -> None:
        self._now = _require_aware(start, "start")
        self._start = self._now

    @property
    def start(self) -> datetime:
        return self._start

    def now(self) -> datetime:
        """Return the current simulated instant (aware UTC)."""
        return self._now

    def advance_to(self, t: datetime) -> datetime:
        """Move forward to ``t`` (no-op if equal); earlier or naive ``t`` raises."""
        target = _require_aware(t, "t")
        if target < self._now:
            raise ValueError(
                f"replay clock cannot move backwards: {target.isoformat()} < "
                f"{self._now.isoformat()}"
            )
        self._now = target
        return self._now

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ presentation

    def local_now(self) -> datetime:
        """Current instant presented in America/New_York."""
        return self._now.astimezone(NEW_YORK)

    def session_date(self) -> date:
        """New York calendar date of the current instant."""
        return self.local_now().date()

    def session_status(self) -> SessionStatus:
        """PRE_OPEN / REGULAR / CLOSED / HOLIDAY / UNKNOWN at the current instant."""
        return _nyse.session_status(self._now)

    def is_regular_hours(self) -> bool:
        return _nyse.is_regular_hours(self._now)

    def current_session(self) -> Session | None:
        """Session of the current New York date, or ``None`` on a no-session day."""
        day = self.session_date()
        if not _nyse.SUPPORTED_YEAR_START <= day.year <= _nyse.SUPPORTED_YEAR_END:
            return None
        if not _nyse.is_trading_day(day):
            return None
        return _nyse.session_for(day)

    def session_open(self) -> datetime | None:
        """UTC open of today's session, or ``None`` on a holiday/weekend."""
        session = self.current_session()
        return None if session is None else session.open_utc

    def session_close(self) -> datetime | None:
        """UTC effective close (early closes included), or ``None`` if no session."""
        session = self.current_session()
        return None if session is None else session.close_utc

    def is_early_close(self) -> bool:
        session = self.current_session()
        return bool(session is not None and session.is_early_close)

    def at_session_open(self) -> bool:
        """True exactly at the session's opening instant."""
        return self._now == self.session_open()

    def at_session_close(self) -> bool:
        """True exactly at the session's closing instant."""
        return self._now == self.session_close()

    def time_to_close(self) -> timedelta | None:
        """Time left in the regular session, or ``None`` outside of it."""
        if not self.is_regular_hours():
            return None
        close = self.session_close()
        return None if close is None else close - self._now

    def next_session(self) -> Session:
        """First session strictly after the current New York date."""
        return _nyse.next_session(self.session_date())

            account_scope_id=account_scope_id,

            remaining_total_usd=effective,

def discover_migrations(migrations_dir: str | Path | None = None) -> tuple[_Migration, ...]:

        if migrations_dir is not None

    )

    versions: set[int] = set()
    paths = directory.iterdir() if directory.is_dir() else ()
    for path in sorted(paths, key=lambda item: item.name):
        match = _MIGRATION_RE.fullmatch(path.name)

        text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")

            _Migration(

                name=match.group("name"),
                path=path,
                text=text,
                sha256=hashlib.sha256(text.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest(),

        )
