+"""Deterministic offline backtest orchestration and research metrics.
+
+Run artifacts use immutable run-scoped JSON files because changing the existing
+SQLite persistence schema would require a migration outside this task's scope.
+All collaborators are injected; this module never constructs a broker client.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+import json
+import random
+from collections import defaultdict
+from dataclasses import dataclass, field
+from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta
+from decimal import Decimal
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any, Callable, Mapping, Sequence
+from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
+
+from mike_trade.backtest.clock import ReplayClock
+from mike_trade.backtest.execution import HistoricalExecutionSimulator
+from mike_trade.backtest.feed import HistoricalReplayFeed, ReplayEvent
+from mike_trade.backtest.manifest import (
+    HoldoutLock, HoldoutViolationError, PeriodRole, RunManifest, canonical_json,
+    code_revision, config_hash, write_manifest,
+)
+from mike_trade.domain.market import Candle, Timeframe
+from mike_trade.market_data.candles import Candle as StrategyCandle, CandleOrigin, CandleStatus, CandleTimeframe, PriceBasis
+from mike_trade.market_data.context import ContextFreshness, MarketContext
+from mike_trade.scheduling.calendar import NEW_YORK, SessionStatus
+from mike_trade.scheduling.scheduler import CandleClosedEvent, StrategyScheduler
+from mike_trade.scheduling.triggers import StrategyTrigger, TriggerKind
+from mike_trade.strategies.base import StrategyEvaluation
+from mike_trade.strategies.registry import StrategyRegistry
+
+__all__ = ["BacktestRequest", "BacktestResult", "BacktestRunner", "BacktestMetrics", "compute_metrics"]
+
+ZERO = Decimal("0")
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class BacktestRequest:
+    symbols: tuple[str, ...]
+    window_start: datetime
+    window_end: datetime
+    period_role: PeriodRole
+    config: Mapping[str, Any]
+    seed: int
+    starting_capital: Decimal
+    strategy_ids: tuple[str, ...]
+    strategy_params: Mapping[str, Mapping[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=dict)
+    strategy_versions: Mapping[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)
+    holdout_lock: HoldoutLock | None = None
+    broker: object | None = None
+    result_directory: str | Path = ".backtest-runs"
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        if not 1 <= len(self.symbols) <= 10:
+            raise ValueError("backtest requires 1-10 operator-supplied symbols")
+        if self.window_start.tzinfo is None or self.window_end.tzinfo is None:
+            raise ValueError("backtest requires an explicit bounded aware window")
+        if self.window_end <= self.window_start:
+            raise ValueError("window_end must be after window_start")
+        if not isinstance(self.starting_capital, Decimal) or self.starting_capital <= ZERO:
+            raise ValueError("starting_capital must be positive Decimal")
+        if isinstance(self.seed, bool) or not isinstance(self.seed, int):
+            raise ValueError("seed must be int")
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class BacktestResult:
+    run_id: str
+    manifest: RunManifest
+    evaluations: tuple[Mapping[str, Any], ...]
+    signals: tuple[Mapping[str, Any], ...]
+    intents: tuple[Mapping[str, Any], ...]
+    fills: tuple[Mapping[str, Any], ...]
+    cycles: tuple[Mapping[str, Any], ...]
+    equity_curve: tuple[Mapping[str, Any], ...]
+    results_hash: str
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class BacktestMetrics:
+    total_return: Decimal
+    net_return: Decimal
+    cash: Decimal
+    equity_curve: tuple[Mapping[str, Any], ...]
+    trades: tuple[Mapping[str, Any], ...]
+    max_drawdown: Decimal
+    profit_factor: Decimal | None
+    win_rate: Decimal
+    average_win: Decimal | None
+    average_loss: Decimal | None
+    expectancy_net: Decimal
+    mfe_mae: tuple[Mapping[str, Any], ...]
+    by_symbol: Mapping[str, Any]
+    by_month: Mapping[str, Any]
+    by_time_of_day: Mapping[str, Any]
+    capital_utilization: Decimal
+    sample_size: int
+    expectancy_bootstrap_ci: tuple[Decimal, Decimal] | None
+    warnings: tuple[str, ...]
+
+
+def _decimal(value: Any) -> Decimal:
+    if isinstance(value, Decimal):
+        return value
+    if isinstance(value, str):
+        return Decimal(value)
+    raise TypeError("metric money, quantities and prices must be Decimal or decimal strings")
+
+
+def _dt(value: Any) -> datetime:
+    return value if isinstance(value, datetime) else datetime.fromisoformat(str(value).replace("Z", "+00:00"))
+
+
+def _trade_records(fills: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    """Pair long entries/exits FIFO, preserving costs and timestamps."""
+    queues: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(list)
+    trades: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    ordered = sorted(fills, key=lambda f: _dt(f["time"]))
+    for fill in ordered:
+        symbol = str(fill["symbol"]).upper()
+        side = str(fill["side"]).upper()
+        qty, price, fee = _decimal(fill["quantity"]), _decimal(fill["price"]), _decimal(fill.get("fee", "0"))
+        at = _dt(fill["time"])
+        if side in ("BUY", "B"):
+            queues[symbol].append({"qty": qty, "price": price, "fee": fee, "time": at,
+                                   "high": _decimal(fill.get("high", price)), "low": _decimal(fill.get("low", price)),
+                                   "entry_time": at})
+            continue
+        if side not in ("SELL", "S"):
+            continue
+        remaining = qty
+        while remaining > ZERO and queues[symbol]:
+            lot = queues[symbol][0]
+            matched = min(remaining, lot["qty"])
+            fraction = matched / qty
+            entry_fee = lot["fee"] * (matched / (matched + lot["qty"] - matched)) if lot["qty"] else ZERO
+            exit_fee = fee * fraction
+            gross = (price - lot["price"]) * matched
+            pnl = gross - entry_fee - exit_fee
+            trades.append({"symbol": symbol, "entry_time": lot["time"], "exit_time": at,
+                           "entry_price": lot["price"], "exit_price": price, "quantity": matched,
+                           "gross_pnl": gross, "costs": entry_fee + exit_fee, "pnl": pnl,
+                           "hold_duration_seconds": Decimal(str((at-lot["time"]).total_seconds())),
+                           "mfe": (lot["high"]-lot["price"]) * matched,
+                           "mae": (lot["low"]-lot["price"]) * matched})
+            lot["qty"] -= matched
+            remaining -= matched
+            if lot["qty"] == ZERO:
+                queues[symbol].pop(0)
+    return trades
+
+
+def compute_metrics(
+    results: BacktestResult | Mapping[str, Any] | Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]],
+    *, starting_capital: Decimal,
+    seed: int = 0,
+    bootstrap_samples: int = 2000,
+    small_sample_threshold: int = 30,
+    bars: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]] = (),
+) -> BacktestMetrics:
+    """Compute descriptive, cost-aware statistics from persisted fills/results."""
+    if isinstance(results, BacktestResult):
+        fills = results.fills
+        curve = results.equity_curve
+    elif isinstance(results, Mapping):
+        fills = results.get("fills", ())
+        curve = results.get("equity_curve", ())
+    else:
+        fills = results
+        curve = ()
+    capital = _decimal(starting_capital)
+    trades = _trade_records(fills)
+    cumulative = capital
+    generated_curve: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    peak = capital
+    max_dd = ZERO
+    for trade in trades:
+        cumulative += trade["pnl"]
+        peak = max(peak, cumulative)
+        if peak:
+            max_dd = max(max_dd, (peak-cumulative)/peak)
+        generated_curve.append({"time": trade["exit_time"], "cash": cumulative, "equity": cumulative})
+    equity = tuple(curve) if curve else tuple(generated_curve)
+    net_pnl = sum((t["pnl"] for t in trades), ZERO)
+    gross_wins = sum((t["pnl"] for t in trades if t["pnl"] > ZERO), ZERO)
+    gross_losses = -sum((t["pnl"] for t in trades if t["pnl"] < ZERO), ZERO)
+    wins = [t["pnl"] for t in trades if t["pnl"] > ZERO]
+    losses = [t["pnl"] for t in trades if t["pnl"] < ZERO]
+    n = len(trades)
+    expectancy = net_pnl / n if n else ZERO
+    by_symbol: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(list)
+    by_month: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(list)
+    by_tod: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(list)
+    for t in trades:
+        local = t["entry_time"].astimezone(NEW_YORK)
+        by_symbol[t["symbol"]].append(t)
+        by_month[local.strftime("%Y-%m")].append(t)
+        bucket = f"{local.hour:02d}:{(local.minute//30)*30:02d}"
+        by_tod[bucket].append(t)
+    summarize = lambda groups: {key: {"count": len(vals), "net_pnl": sum((x["pnl"] for x in vals), ZERO),
+                                       "win_rate": Decimal(sum(x["pnl"] > ZERO for x in vals))/len(vals)}
+                                for key, vals in sorted(groups.items())}
+    sample_ci = None
+    if n and bootstrap_samples > 0:
+        rng = random.Random(seed)
+        samples = sorted(sum((trades[rng.randrange(n)]["pnl"] for _ in range(n)), ZERO)/n
+                         for _ in range(bootstrap_samples))
+        sample_ci = (samples[int((bootstrap_samples-1)*Decimal("0.025"))],
+                     samples[int((bootstrap_samples-1)*Decimal("0.975"))])
+    warnings = (f"small sample: {n} closed trades; threshold is {small_sample_threshold}",) if n < small_sample_threshold else ()
+    excursions: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for t in trades:
+        holding = [b for b in bars if str(b["symbol"]).upper() == t["symbol"] and
+                   t["entry_time"] <= _dt(b["time"]) <= t["exit_time"]]
+        if holding:
+            high = max(_decimal(b["high"]) for b in holding)
+            low = min(_decimal(b["low"]) for b in holding)
+            t["mfe"] = max(ZERO, high-t["entry_price"])*t["quantity"]
+            t["mae"] = min(ZERO, low-t["entry_price"])*t["quantity"]
+        excursions.append({"symbol": t["symbol"], "entry_time": t["entry_time"], "mfe": t["mfe"], "mae": t["mae"]})
+    utilization = ZERO
+    if equity:
+        max_equity = max((_decimal(p.get("equity", p.get("cash", capital))) for p in equity), default=capital)
+        notionals = [sum((_decimal(f["quantity"])*_decimal(f["price"]) for f in fills
+                          if str(f["side"]).upper() in ("BUY", "B")), ZERO)]
+        utilization = min(Decimal(1), (notionals[0]/max_equity) if max_equity else ZERO)
+    final_cash = cumulative if not equity else _decimal(equity[-1].get("cash", equity[-1].get("equity", cumulative)))
+    final_equity = cumulative if not equity else _decimal(equity[-1].get("equity", final_cash))
+    return BacktestMetrics(
+        total_return=(final_equity-capital)/capital,
+        net_return=net_pnl/capital,
+        cash=final_cash,
+        equity_curve=equity,
+        trades=tuple(trades),
+        max_drawdown=max_dd,
+        profit_factor=None if gross_losses == ZERO else gross_wins/gross_losses,
+        win_rate=Decimal(len(wins))/n if n else ZERO,
+        average_win=sum(wins, ZERO)/len(wins) if wins else None,
+        average_loss=sum(losses, ZERO)/len(losses) if losses else None,
+        expectancy_net=expectancy,
+        mfe_mae=tuple(excursions), by_symbol=summarize(by_symbol), by_month=summarize(by_month),
+        by_time_of_day=summarize(by_tod), capital_utilization=utilization, sample_size=n,
+        expectancy_bootstrap_ci=sample_ci, warnings=warnings,
+    )
+
+
+class BacktestRunner:
+    """Run registered strategies over a supplied replay feed and simulator."""
+    def __init__(self, registry: StrategyRegistry, feed: HistoricalReplayFeed,
+                 clock: ReplayClock, execution: HistoricalExecutionSimulator,
+                 *, scheduler: StrategyScheduler | None = None,
+                 intent_factory: Callable[..., Any] | None = None,
+                 budget_policy: Any = None, eligibility_policy: Any = None,
+                 position_coordinator: Any = None, cycle_accounting: Any = None,
+                 protection_math: Any = None) -> None:
+        self.registry, self.feed, self.clock, self.execution = registry, feed, clock, execution
+        self.scheduler = scheduler or StrategyScheduler(clock)
+        self.intent_factory = intent_factory
+        self.policies = (budget_policy, eligibility_policy, position_coordinator, cycle_accounting, protection_math)
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _reject_real_broker(broker: object | None, execution: object) -> None:
+        for candidate in (broker, execution):
+            if candidate is None:
+                continue
+            module = type(candidate).__module__.lower()
+            name = type(candidate).__name__.lower()
+            environment = str(getattr(candidate, "environment", "")).lower()
+            if "alpaca" in module or "alpaca" in name or environment in {"paper", "live"}:
+                raise ValueError("real Alpaca/paper/live broker clients are refused in backtests")
+
+    async def run(self, request: BacktestRequest) -> BacktestResult:
+        self._reject_real_broker(request.broker, self.execution)
+        role = PeriodRole(request.period_role)
+        provenance = self.feed.provenance
+        strategies = []
+        for strategy_id in request.strategy_ids:
+            cls = self.registry.get(strategy_id, request.strategy_versions.get(strategy_id))
+            strategies.append(cls)
+        effective = dict(request.config)
+        effective.update({"seed": request.seed, "strategy_ids": list(request.strategy_ids),
+                          "strategy_versions": {c.spec.strategy_id:c.spec.version for c in strategies},
+                          "strategy_params": request.strategy_params})
+        digest = config_hash(effective)
+        if role is PeriodRole.HOLDOUT:
+            lock = request.holdout_lock
+            if lock is None:
+                raise HoldoutViolationError("HOLDOUT requires an explicit holdout lock token")
+            if lock.research_config_hash != digest:
+                raise HoldoutViolationError("holdout config differs from locked research configuration")
+            if request.window_start.astimezone(UTC) < lock.window_start or request.window_end.astimezone(UTC) > lock.window_end:
+                raise HoldoutViolationError("HOLDOUT run must stay within locked holdout window")
+            access = {"token": lock.token, "accessed_at": self.clock.now()}
+        else:
+            access = None
+            lock = request.holdout_lock
+            if lock and request.window_start.astimezone(UTC) < lock.window_end and request.window_end.astimezone(UTC) > lock.window_start:
+                raise HoldoutViolationError("research/dev window overlaps locked holdout window")
+        dataset_hash = provenance.dataset_hash or ""
+        run_id = hashlib.sha256(canonical_json({"config_hash":digest,"dataset_hash":dataset_hash,
+                            "symbols":sorted(request.symbols),"start":request.window_start,
+                            "end":request.window_end,"role":role.value}).encode()).hexdigest()
+        assumptions = self.execution.assumptions
+        amap = dict(assumptions.as_mapping())
+        manifest = RunManifest(run_id, request.window_start, digest, tuple(request.symbols),
+            request.window_start, request.window_end, role, code_revision(),
+            {"source":provenance.source,"feed":provenance.feed,"is_consolidated":provenance.is_consolidated,
+             "adjustment":provenance.adjustment,"point_in_time":provenance.point_in_time},
+            provenance.revision, provenance.revision, dataset_hash, str(request.starting_capital),
+            {k:v for k,v in amap.items() if k.startswith("fee_")},
+            {k:v for k,v in amap.items() if "slippage" in k},
+            {k:v for k,v in amap.items() if "fill" in k},
+            {k:v for k,v in amap.items() if "ambiguity" in k}, request.seed,
+            tuple({"name":c.spec.strategy_id,"version":c.spec.version} for c in strategies), access)
+        root = Path(request.result_directory)
+        write_manifest(manifest, root)
+        evaluations: list[Mapping[str, Any]] = []
+        signals: list[Mapping[str, Any]] = []
+        intents: list[Mapping[str, Any]] = []
+        fills: list[Mapping[str, Any]] = []
+        candles_by_symbol: dict[str,list[Candle]] = defaultdict(list)
+        replay_events = [e for e in self.feed.events(symbols=request.symbols)
+                         if e.available_at and request.window_start <= e.available_at <= request.window_end]
+        trigger_rows: set[tuple[str,str,datetime]] = set()
+        state: dict[tuple[str,str],dict[str,Any]] = defaultdict(dict)
+        params = {sid: self.registry.validate_parameters(sid, request.strategy_params.get(sid, {}), request.strategy_versions.get(sid)) for sid in request.strategy_ids}
+        for ev in replay_events:
+            assert ev.available_at
+            self.clock.advance_to(ev.available_at)
+            outputs = self.execution.process_event(ev)
+            fills.extend({"symbol":x.symbol,"side":x.side.value,"quantity":x.quantity,"price":x.price,
+                          "fee":x.fee,"time":x.fill.filled_at,"order_id":x.fill.order_id,
+                          "evidence":x.evidence} for x in outputs)
+            if ev.kind != ReplayEvent.KIND_BAR or ev.candle is None:
+                continue
+            candles_by_symbol[ev.symbol].append(ev.candle)
+            due = self.scheduler.process(CandleClosedEvent(ev.symbol, CandleTimeframe(ev.candle.timeframe.value), ev.candle.end,
+                                                           snapshot_version=len(candles_by_symbol[ev.symbol]), due_at=ev.available_at))
+            # Registry class specs drive closed-bar trigger cadence and evaluation.
+            for cls in strategies:
+                spec = cls.spec
+                if ev.candle.timeframe.value != spec.trigger_timeframe.value or len(candles_by_symbol[ev.symbol]) < max(1,spec.warmup_bars):
+                    continue
+                key=(ev.symbol,spec.strategy_id,ev.candle.start)
+                if key in trigger_rows: continue
+                trigger_rows.add(key)
+                history=tuple(candles_by_symbol[ev.symbol][-max(spec.warmup_bars+1,1):])
+                spec_tf=CandleTimeframe(spec.trigger_timeframe.value)
+                converted=tuple(StrategyCandle(c.symbol,spec_tf,c.start,c.end,c.open,c.high,c.low,c.close,
+                    c.volume,c.provenance.feed,c.provenance.is_consolidated,CandleOrigin.REPLAY,
+                    PriceBasis.RAW,CandleStatus.CLOSED,c.trade_count) for c in history)
+                session_status=self.clock.session_status()
+                age=ev.available_at-ev.candle.end
+                freshness=ContextFreshness(ev.candle.end,max(age, timedelta(0)), timedelta(minutes=5),False,None)
+                context=MarketContext(ev.symbol,ev.available_at,len(candles_by_symbol[ev.symbol]),
+                    provenance.feed,provenance.is_consolidated,PriceBasis.RAW,session_status,
+                    ev.available_at.astimezone(NEW_YORK).date().isoformat(),freshness,
+                    {spec_tf:converted},{})
+                strategy=cls()
+                evaluation: StrategyEvaluation=strategy.evaluate(context,params[spec.strategy_id],state[(ev.symbol,spec.strategy_id)])
+                state[(ev.symbol,spec.strategy_id)].update(evaluation.state_updates)
+                row={"symbol":ev.symbol,"strategy":spec.strategy_id,"version":spec.version,
+                     "time":ev.available_at,"bar_time":ev.candle.start,"signal_id":evaluation.signal_id,
+                     "reason_codes":[x.value for x in evaluation.reason_codes]}
+                evaluations.append(row)
+                if evaluation.is_signal:
+                    signals.append(row)
+                    if self.intent_factory is not None:
+                        intent=self.intent_factory(evaluation, context, request)
+                        intents.append({"symbol":ev.symbol,"strategy":spec.strategy_id,"time":ev.available_at,
+                                        "intent_id":getattr(intent,"intent_id",None)})
+                        order=await self.execution.submit_order(intent)
+                        self.execution.process_event(ev)
+            # Other event kinds (quotes/splits/data-quality) are processed in chronology too.
+        payload={"evaluations":evaluations,"signals":signals,"intents":intents,"fills":fills,
+                 "cycles":[],"equity_curve":[]}
+        result_hash=hashlib.sha256(canonical_json(payload).encode()).hexdigest()
+        result_path=root/f"{run_id}.results.json"
+        result_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
+        with result_path.open("x",encoding="utf-8",newline="\n") as f:
+            f.write(canonical_json(payload)); f.flush()
+        return BacktestResult(run_id,manifest,tuple(evaluations),tuple(signals),tuple(intents),tuple(fills),(),(),result_hash)

+"""Offline reproducibility and research-metric checks for backtest artifacts."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta
+from decimal import Decimal as D
+
+import pytest
+
+from mike_trade.backtest.clock import ReplayClock
+from mike_trade.backtest.execution import ExecutionAssumptions, HistoricalExecutionSimulator
+from mike_trade.backtest.feed import DataProvenance, HistoricalReplayFeed, ReplayEvent
+from mike_trade.backtest.manifest import (
+    HoldoutLock, HoldoutViolationError, PeriodRole, RunManifest, config_hash,
+    write_manifest,
+)
+from mike_trade.backtest.runner import BacktestRequest, BacktestRunner, compute_metrics
+from mike_trade.domain.market import Candle, FeedProvenance, Timeframe
+from mike_trade.strategies.presets.buy_presets import build_buy_registry
+
+
+UTC0 = datetime(2025, 3, 10, 13, 30, tzinfo=UTC)
+MIN = timedelta(minutes=1)
+PROV = DataProvenance("synthetic", "IEX", False, "r1")
+FEED_PROV = FeedProvenance("replay", "IEX", "synthetic", False)
+
+
+def _event(minute: int, price: str = "100") -> ReplayEvent:
+    start = UTC0 + minute * MIN
+    px = D(price)
+    return ReplayEvent.bar(Candle("AAA", Timeframe.M1, start, start+MIN,
+        px, px, px, px, D("1000"), FEED_PROV))
+
+
+def _runner(seed: int = 7):
+    clock = ReplayClock(UTC0)
+    feed = HistoricalReplayFeed([_event(0), _event(1)], PROV, clock=clock, seed=seed)
+    execution = HistoricalExecutionSimulator(feed, clock, ExecutionAssumptions())
+    return clock, feed, execution
+
+
+def _request(tmp_path, seed=7, role=PeriodRole.RESEARCH, lock=None):
+    return BacktestRequest(
+        symbols=("AAA",), window_start=UTC0, window_end=UTC0+timedelta(minutes=5),
+        period_role=role, config={"model": "baseline"}, seed=seed,
+        starting_capital=D("1000"), strategy_ids=("momentum_breakout",),
+        strategy_params={"momentum_breakout": {"lookback_bars": 2, "volume_multiple": D("1")}},
+        holdout_lock=lock, result_directory=tmp_path,
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_identical_runs_and_seed_changes_are_content_addressed(tmp_path):
+    c1, f1, e1 = _runner()
+    a = await BacktestRunner(build_buy_registry(), f1, c1, e1).run(_request(tmp_path / "a"))
+    c2, f2, e2 = _runner()

"""Deterministic NYSE session calendar.

The calendar is rule based and intentionally performs no I/O. Session dates are
interpreted in New York time; all public instant values are returned in UTC.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import UTC, date, datetime, time, timedelta
from enum import Enum
from types import MappingProxyType
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo

NEW_YORK = ZoneInfo("America/New_York")
SUPPORTED_YEAR_START = 2000
SUPPORTED_YEAR_END = 2035


class SessionStatus(str, Enum):
    PRE_OPEN = "PRE_OPEN"
    REGULAR = "REGULAR"
    CLOSED = "CLOSED"
    HOLIDAY = "HOLIDAY"
    UNKNOWN = "UNKNOWN"


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Session:
    """An immutable regular NYSE session, including its effective close."""

    session_id: str
    session_date: date
    open_et: datetime
    close_et: datetime
    is_early_close: bool
    open_utc: datetime
    close_utc: datetime


# Override entries augment the published rule calendar.  Values are either
# ``"closed"`` or an early close time expressed as an ET wall-clock time.
SPECIAL_OVERRIDES: MappingProxyType[date, str | time] = MappingProxyType(
    {
        date(2025, 1, 9): "closed",  # National day of mourning for President Carter.
    }
)


def _check_year(day: date) -> None:
    if not SUPPORTED_YEAR_START <= day.year <= SUPPORTED_YEAR_END:
        raise ValueError(
            f"date year {day.year} is outside supported range "
            f"{SUPPORTED_YEAR_START}-{SUPPORTED_YEAR_END}"
        )


def _observed_fixed(day: date, *, new_year: bool = False) -> date | None:
    """Return a fixed-date holiday's observed date under NYSE rules."""
    if day.weekday() == 5:
        return None if new_year else day - timedelta(days=1)
    if day.weekday() == 6:
        return day + timedelta(days=1)
    return day


def _easter_sunday(year: int) -> date:
    """Gregorian Easter computus (Meeus/Jones/Butcher)."""
    a = year % 19
    b, c = divmod(year, 100)
    d, e = divmod(b, 4)
    f = (b + 8) // 25
    g = (b - f + 1) // 3
    h = (19 * a + b - d - g + 15) % 30
    i, k = divmod(c, 4)
    l = (32 + 2 * e + 2 * i - h - k) % 7
    m = (a + 11 * h + 22 * l) // 451
    month, day_num = divmod(h + l - 7 * m + 114, 31)
    return date(year, month, day_num + 1)


def _nth_weekday(year: int, month: int, weekday: int, n: int) -> date:
    first = date(year, month, 1)
    return first + timedelta(days=(weekday - first.weekday()) % 7 + 7 * (n - 1))


def _last_weekday(year: int, month: int, weekday: int) -> date:
    last_day = date(year + (month == 12), month % 12 + 1, 1) - timedelta(days=1)
    return last_day - timedelta(days=(last_day.weekday() - weekday) % 7)


def _holidays(year: int) -> frozenset[date]:
    holidays: set[date] = {
        _nth_weekday(year, 1, 0, 3),  # Martin Luther King Jr. Day
        _nth_weekday(year, 2, 0, 3),  # Washington's Birthday
        _last_weekday(year, 5, 0),  # Memorial Day
        _easter_sunday(year) - timedelta(days=2),  # Good Friday
        _nth_weekday(year, 9, 0, 1),  # Labor Day
        _nth_weekday(year, 11, 3, 4),  # Thanksgiving
    }

+"""Immutable, content-addressed backtest run manifests.
+
+Manifests and run results are stored in run-scoped files by :mod:`runner`; the
+existing SQLite schema is deliberately unchanged for this task.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+import subprocess
+from dataclasses import dataclass, fields, is_dataclass
+from datetime import UTC, datetime
+from decimal import Decimal
+from enum import StrEnum
+from pathlib import Path
+from types import MappingProxyType
+from typing import Any, Mapping
+
+
+class PeriodRole(StrEnum):
+    RESEARCH = "RESEARCH"
+    DEV = "DEV"
+    HOLDOUT = "HOLDOUT"
+
+
+class HoldoutViolationError(ValueError):
+    """A holdout access or retuning rule was violated."""
+
+
+def canonical_json(value: Any) -> str:
+    """Canonical JSON for manifest/config/result hashing; rejects floats."""
+    def normalize(item: Any) -> Any:
+        if isinstance(item, datetime):
+            if item.tzinfo is None or item.utcoffset() is None:
+                raise ValueError("datetimes must be timezone-aware")
+            return item.astimezone(UTC).isoformat(timespec="microseconds").replace("+00:00", "Z")
+        if hasattr(item, "value") and isinstance(item.value, (str, int)):
+            return item.value
+        if isinstance(item, float):
+            raise TypeError("floats are not allowed in canonical backtest values")
+        if isinstance(item, Mapping):
+            return {str(k): normalize(v) for k, v in item.items()}
+        if isinstance(item, (list, tuple)):
+            return [normalize(v) for v in item]
+        if isinstance(item, (str, int, bool)) or item is None:
+            return item
+        if hasattr(item, "as_mapping"):
+            return normalize(item.as_mapping())
+        if isinstance(item, Decimal):
+            if not item.is_finite():
+                raise ValueError("non-finite Decimal is not canonical")
+            return format(item, "f")
+        if is_dataclass(item):
+            return normalize({field.name: getattr(item, field.name) for field in fields(item)})
+        raise TypeError(f"unsupported canonical value {type(item).__name__}")
+
+    return json.dumps(normalize(value), sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=True)
+
+
+def config_hash(config: Mapping[str, Any]) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(canonical_json(config).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
+
+
+def code_revision(cwd: str | Path | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Capture local git commit and dirty status without network access."""
+    try:
+        commit = subprocess.run(
+            ["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], cwd=cwd, check=True, capture_output=True,
+            text=True, timeout=2,
+        ).stdout.strip()
+        dirty = bool(subprocess.run(
+            ["git", "status", "--porcelain"], cwd=cwd, check=True, capture_output=True,
+            text=True, timeout=2,
+        ).stdout.strip())
+    except (OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError):
+        commit, dirty = "unknown", False
+    return {"commit": commit, "dirty": dirty}
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class HoldoutLock:
+    """Operator authorization and locked research/window identity."""
+    token: str
+    research_config_hash: str
+    window_start: datetime
+    window_end: datetime
+    enabled: bool = True
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        if not self.token or not self.enabled:
+            raise HoldoutViolationError("holdout access requires an enabled explicit lock token")
+        for name in ("window_start", "window_end"):
+            value = getattr(self, name)
+            if value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
+                raise ValueError(f"{name} must be timezone-aware")
+            object.__setattr__(self, name, value.astimezone(UTC))
+        if self.window_end <= self.window_start:
+            raise ValueError("holdout window must be bounded and non-empty")
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class RunManifest:
+    run_id: str
+    created_at: datetime
+    config_hash: str
+    symbols: tuple[str, ...]
+    window_start: datetime
+    window_end: datetime
+    period_role: PeriodRole
+    code_revision: Mapping[str, Any]
+    data_provenance: Mapping[str, Any]
+    data_revision: str
+    data_vintage: str
+    dataset_hash: str
+    starting_capital: str
+    fee_assumptions: Mapping[str, Any]
+    slippage_assumptions: Mapping[str, Any]
+    fill_assumptions: Mapping[str, Any]
+    ambiguity_assumptions: Mapping[str, Any]
+    seed: int
+    strategies: tuple[Mapping[str, str], ...]
+    holdout_access: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        if not self.run_id or not self.config_hash:
+            raise ValueError("run_id and config_hash are required")
+        if not isinstance(self.period_role, PeriodRole):
+            object.__setattr__(self, "period_role", PeriodRole(self.period_role))
+        for name in ("created_at", "window_start", "window_end"):
+            dt = getattr(self, name)
+            if dt.tzinfo is None or dt.utcoffset() is None:
+                raise ValueError(f"{name} must be timezone-aware")
+            object.__setattr__(self, name, dt.astimezone(UTC))
+        if self.window_end <= self.window_start:
+            raise ValueError("window must be bounded and non-empty")
+        if not 1 <= len(self.symbols) <= 10:
+            raise ValueError("manifest requires 1-10 symbols")
+        object.__setattr__(self, "symbols", tuple(sorted({s.upper() for s in self.symbols})))
+        for name in ("code_revision", "data_provenance", "fee_assumptions", "slippage_assumptions",
+                     "fill_assumptions", "ambiguity_assumptions", "holdout_access"):
+            value = getattr(self, name)
+            if value is not None:
+                object.__setattr__(self, name, MappingProxyType(dict(value)))
+        object.__setattr__(self, "strategies", tuple(MappingProxyType(dict(v)) for v in self.strategies))
+        if isinstance(self.seed, bool) or not isinstance(self.seed, int):
+            raise ValueError("seed must be int")
+
+    def canonical(self) -> str:
+        return canonical_json({field.name: getattr(self, field.name) for field in fields(self)})
+
+    @property
+    def content_hash(self) -> str:
+        return hashlib.sha256(self.canonical().encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
+
+    @classmethod
+    def from_json(cls, value: str) -> "RunManifest":
+        raw = json.loads(value)
+        for field in ("created_at", "window_start", "window_end"):
+            raw[field] = datetime.fromisoformat(raw[field].replace("Z", "+00:00"))
+        raw["period_role"] = PeriodRole(raw["period_role"])
+        raw["symbols"] = tuple(raw["symbols"])
+        raw["strategies"] = tuple(raw["strategies"])
+        return cls(**raw)
+
+
+def write_manifest(manifest: RunManifest, directory: str | Path) -> Path:
+    """Create once; exclusive creation rejects any existing run id."""
+    target = Path(directory) / f"{manifest.run_id}.manifest.json"
+    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    payload = manifest.canonical()
+    with target.open("x", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as stream:
+        stream.write(payload)
+        stream.flush()
+        os.fsync(stream.fileno())
+    return target

+def _decimal(value: Any) -> Decimal:
+    if isinstance(value, Decimal):
+        return value
+    if isinstance(value, str):
+        return Decimal(value)
+    raise TypeError("metric money, quantities and prices must be Decimal or decimal strings")

+def _dt(value: Any) -> datetime:
+    return value if isinstance(value, datetime) else datetime.fromisoformat(str(value).replace("Z", "+00:00"))

+def _trade_records(fills: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    """Pair long entries/exits FIFO, preserving costs and timestamps."""
+    queues: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(list)
+    trades: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    ordered = sorted(fills, key=lambda f: _dt(f["time"]))
+    for fill in ordered:
+        symbol = str(fill["symbol"]).upper()
+        side = str(fill["side"]).upper()
+        qty, price, fee = _decimal(fill["quantity"]), _decimal(fill["price"]), _decimal(fill.get("fee", "0"))
+        at = _dt(fill["time"])
+        if side in ("BUY", "B"):
+            queues[symbol].append({"qty": qty, "price": price, "fee": fee, "time": at,
+                                   "high": _decimal(fill.get("high", price)), "low": _decimal(fill.get("low", price)),
+                                   "entry_time": at})
+            continue

+            lot = queues[symbol][0]

+            fraction = matched / qty

+            exit_fee = fee * fraction

+                           "gross_pnl": gross, "costs": entry_fee + exit_fee, "pnl": pnl,
+                           "hold_duration_seconds": Decimal(str((at-lot["time"]).total_seconds())),
+                           "mfe": (lot["high"]-lot["price"]) * matched,
+                           "mae": (lot["low"]-lot["price"]) * matched})

+"""Immutable, content-addressed backtest run manifests.
+
+Manifests and run results are stored in run-scoped files by :mod:`runner`; the
+existing SQLite schema is deliberately unchanged for this task.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+import subprocess
+from dataclasses import dataclass, fields, is_dataclass
+from datetime import UTC, datetime
+from decimal import Decimal
+from enum import StrEnum
+from pathlib import Path
+from types import MappingProxyType
+from typing import Any, Mapping
+
+
+class PeriodRole(StrEnum):
+    RESEARCH = "RESEARCH"
+    DEV = "DEV"
+    HOLDOUT = "HOLDOUT"
+
+
+class HoldoutViolationError(ValueError):
+    """A holdout access or retuning rule was violated."""
+
+
+def canonical_json(value: Any) -> str:
+    """Canonical JSON for manifest/config/result hashing; rejects floats."""
+    def normalize(item: Any) -> Any:
+        if isinstance(item, datetime):
+            if item.tzinfo is None or item.utcoffset() is None:
+                raise ValueError("datetimes must be timezone-aware")
+            return item.astimezone(UTC).isoformat(timespec="microseconds").replace("+00:00", "Z")
+        if hasattr(item, "value") and isinstance(item.value, (str, int)):
+            return item.value
+        if isinstance(item, float):
+            raise TypeError("floats are not allowed in canonical backtest values")
+        if isinstance(item, Mapping):
+            return {str(k): normalize(v) for k, v in item.items()}
+        if isinstance(item, (list, tuple)):
+            return [normalize(v) for v in item]
+        if isinstance(item, (str, int, bool)) or item is None:
+            return item
+        if hasattr(item, "as_mapping"):
+            return normalize(item.as_mapping())
+        if isinstance(item, Decimal):
+            if not item.is_finite():
+                raise ValueError("non-finite Decimal is not canonical")
+            return format(item, "f")
+        if is_dataclass(item):
+            return normalize({field.name: getattr(item, field.name) for field in fields(item)})
+        raise TypeError(f"unsupported canonical value {type(item).__name__}")
+
+    return json.dumps(normalize(value), sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=True)
+
+
+def config_hash(config: Mapping[str, Any]) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(canonical_json(config).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
+
+
+def code_revision(cwd: str | Path | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Capture local git commit and dirty status without network access."""
+    try:
+        commit = subprocess.run(
+            ["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], cwd=cwd, check=True, capture_output=True,
+            text=True, timeout=2,
+        ).stdout.strip()
+        dirty = bool(subprocess.run(
+            ["git", "status", "--porcelain"], cwd=cwd, check=True, capture_output=True,
+            text=True, timeout=2,
+        ).stdout.strip())
+    except (OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError):
+        commit, dirty = "unknown", False
+    return {"commit": commit, "dirty": dirty}
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class HoldoutLock:
+    """Operator authorization and locked research/window identity."""
+    token: str
+    research_config_hash: str
+    window_start: datetime
+    window_end: datetime
+    enabled: bool = True
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        if not self.token or not self.enabled:
+            raise HoldoutViolationError("holdout access requires an enabled explicit lock token")
+        for name in ("window_start", "window_end"):
+            value = getattr(self, name)
+            if value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
+                raise ValueError(f"{name} must be timezone-aware")
+            object.__setattr__(self, name, value.astimezone(UTC))
+        if self.window_end <= self.window_start:
+            raise ValueError("holdout window must be bounded and non-empty")
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class RunManifest:
+    run_id: str
+    created_at: datetime
+    config_hash: str
+    symbols: tuple[str, ...]
+    window_start: datetime
+    window_end: datetime
+    period_role: PeriodRole
+    code_revision: Mapping[str, Any]
+    data_provenance: Mapping[str, Any]
+    data_revision: str
+    data_vintage: str
+    dataset_hash: str
+    starting_capital: str
+    fee_assumptions: Mapping[str, Any]
+    slippage_assumptions: Mapping[str, Any]
+    fill_assumptions: Mapping[str, Any]
+    ambiguity_assumptions: Mapping[str, Any]
+    seed: int
+    strategies: tuple[Mapping[str, str], ...]
+    holdout_access: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        if not self.run_id or not self.config_hash:
+            raise ValueError("run_id and config_hash are required")
+        if not isinstance(self.period_role, PeriodRole):
+            object.__setattr__(self, "period_role", PeriodRole(self.period_role))
+        for name in ("created_at", "window_start", "window_end"):
+            dt = getattr(self, name)
+            if dt.tzinfo is None or dt.utcoffset() is None:
+                raise ValueError(f"{name} must be timezone-aware")
+            object.__setattr__(self, name, dt.astimezone(UTC))
+        if self.window_end <= self.window_start:
+            raise ValueError("window must be bounded and non-empty")
+        if not 1 <= len(self.symbols) <= 10:
+            raise ValueError("manifest requires 1-10 symbols")
+        object.__setattr__(self, "symbols", tuple(sorted({s.upper() for s in self.symbols})))
+        for name in ("code_revision", "data_provenance", "fee_assumptions", "slippage_assumptions",
+                     "fill_assumptions", "ambiguity_assumptions", "holdout_access"):
+            value = getattr(self, name)
+            if value is not None:
+                object.__setattr__(self, name, MappingProxyType(dict(value)))
+        object.__setattr__(self, "strategies", tuple(MappingProxyType(dict(v)) for v in self.strategies))
+        if isinstance(self.seed, bool) or not isinstance(self.seed, int):
+            raise ValueError("seed must be int")
+
+    def canonical(self) -> str:
+        return canonical_json({field.name: getattr(self, field.name) for field in fields(self)})
+
+    @property
+    def content_hash(self) -> str:
+        return hashlib.sha256(self.canonical().encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
+
+    @classmethod
+    def from_json(cls, value: str) -> "RunManifest":
+        raw = json.loads(value)
+        for field in ("created_at", "window_start", "window_end"):
+            raw[field] = datetime.fromisoformat(raw[field].replace("Z", "+00:00"))
+        raw["period_role"] = PeriodRole(raw["period_role"])
+        raw["symbols"] = tuple(raw["symbols"])
+        raw["strategies"] = tuple(raw["strategies"])
+        return cls(**raw)
+
+
+def write_manifest(manifest: RunManifest, directory: str | Path) -> Path:
+    """Create once; exclusive creation rejects any existing run id."""
+    target = Path(directory) / f"{manifest.run_id}.manifest.json"
+    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    payload = manifest.canonical()
+    with target.open("x", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as stream:
+        stream.write(payload)
+        stream.flush()
+        os.fsync(stream.fileno())
+    return target

+"""Deterministic offline backtest orchestration and research metrics.
+
+Run artifacts use immutable run-scoped JSON files because changing the existing
+SQLite persistence schema would require a migration outside this task's scope.
+All collaborators are injected; this module never constructs a broker client.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+import json
+import random
+from collections import defaultdict
+from dataclasses import dataclass, field
+from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta
+from decimal import Decimal
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any, Callable, Mapping, Sequence
+from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
+
+from mike_trade.backtest.clock import ReplayClock
+from mike_trade.backtest.execution import HistoricalExecutionSimulator
+from mike_trade.backtest.feed import HistoricalReplayFeed, ReplayEvent
+from mike_trade.backtest.manifest import (
+    HoldoutLock, HoldoutViolationError, PeriodRole, RunManifest, canonical_json,
+    code_revision, config_hash, write_manifest,
+)
+from mike_trade.domain.market import Candle, Timeframe
+from mike_trade.market_data.candles import Candle as StrategyCandle, CandleOrigin, CandleStatus, CandleTimeframe, PriceBasis
+from mike_trade.market_data.context import ContextFreshness, MarketContext

+from mike_trade.scheduling.triggers import StrategyTrigger, TriggerKind
+from mike_trade.strategies.base import StrategyEvaluation
+from mike_trade.strategies.registry import StrategyRegistry
+
+__all__ = ["BacktestRequest", "BacktestResult", "BacktestRunner", "BacktestMetrics", "compute_metrics"]
+
+ZERO = Decimal("0")
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class BacktestRequest:
+    symbols: tuple[str, ...]
+    window_start: datetime
+    window_end: datetime
+    period_role: PeriodRole
+    config: Mapping[str, Any]
+    seed: int
+    starting_capital: Decimal
+    strategy_ids: tuple[str, ...]
+    strategy_params: Mapping[str, Mapping[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=dict)
+    strategy_versions: Mapping[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)
+    holdout_lock: HoldoutLock | None = None
+    broker: object | None = None
+    result_directory: str | Path = ".backtest-runs"
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        if not 1 <= len(self.symbols) <= 10:
+            raise ValueError("backtest requires 1-10 operator-supplied symbols")
+        if self.window_start.tzinfo is None or self.window_end.tzinfo is None:
+            raise ValueError("backtest requires an explicit bounded aware window")
+        if self.window_end <= self.window_start:
+            raise ValueError("window_end must be after window_start")
+        if not isinstance(self.starting_capital, Decimal) or self.starting_capital <= ZERO:
+            raise ValueError("starting_capital must be positive Decimal")
+        if isinstance(self.seed, bool) or not isinstance(self.seed, int):
+            raise ValueError("seed must be int")
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class BacktestResult:
+    run_id: str
+    manifest: RunManifest
+    evaluations: tuple[Mapping[str, Any], ...]
+    signals: tuple[Mapping[str, Any], ...]
+    intents: tuple[Mapping[str, Any], ...]
+    fills: tuple[Mapping[str, Any], ...]
+    cycles: tuple[Mapping[str, Any], ...]
+    equity_curve: tuple[Mapping[str, Any], ...]
+    results_hash: str
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class BacktestMetrics:
+    total_return: Decimal
+    net_return: Decimal
+    cash: Decimal
+    equity_curve: tuple[Mapping[str, Any], ...]
+    trades: tuple[Mapping[str, Any], ...]
+    max_drawdown: Decimal
+    profit_factor: Decimal | None
+    win_rate: Decimal
+    average_win: Decimal | None
+    average_loss: Decimal | None
+    expectancy_net: Decimal
+    mfe_mae: tuple[Mapping[str, Any], ...]
+    by_symbol: Mapping[str, Any]
+    by_month: Mapping[str, Any]
+    by_time_of_day: Mapping[str, Any]
+    capital_utilization: Decimal
+    sample_size: int
+    expectancy_bootstrap_ci: tuple[Decimal, Decimal] | None
+    warnings: tuple[str, ...]
+
+
+def _decimal(value: Any) -> Decimal:
+    if isinstance(value, Decimal):
+        return value
+    if isinstance(value, str):
+        return Decimal(value)
+    raise TypeError("metric money, quantities and prices must be Decimal or decimal strings")
+
+
+def _dt(value: Any) -> datetime:
+    return value if isinstance(value, datetime) else datetime.fromisoformat(str(value).replace("Z", "+00:00"))
+
+
+def _trade_records(fills: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    """Pair long entries/exits FIFO, preserving costs and timestamps."""
+    queues: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(list)
+    trades: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    ordered = sorted(fills, key=lambda f: _dt(f["time"]))
+    for fill in ordered:
+        symbol = str(fill["symbol"]).upper()
+        side = str(fill["side"]).upper()
+        qty, price, fee = _decimal(fill["quantity"]), _decimal(fill["price"]), _decimal(fill.get("fee", "0"))
+        at = _dt(fill["time"])
+        if side in ("BUY", "B"):
+            queues[symbol].append({"qty": qty, "price": price, "fee": fee, "time": at,
+                                   "high": _decimal(fill.get("high", price)), "low": _decimal(fill.get("low", price)),
+                                   "entry_time": at})
+            continue
+        if side not in ("SELL", "S"):
+            continue
+        remaining = qty
+        while remaining > ZERO and queues[symbol]:
+            lot = queues[symbol][0]
+            matched = min(remaining, lot["qty"])
+            fraction = matched / qty
+            entry_fee = lot["fee"] * (matched / (matched + lot["qty"] - matched)) if lot["qty"] else ZERO
+            exit_fee = fee * fraction
+            gross = (price - lot["price"]) * matched
+            pnl = gross - entry_fee - exit_fee
+            trades.append({"symbol": symbol, "entry_time": lot["time"], "exit_time": at,
+                           "entry_price": lot["price"], "exit_price": price, "quantity": matched,
+                           "gross_pnl": gross, "costs": entry_fee + exit_fee, "pnl": pnl,
+                           "hold_duration_seconds": Decimal(str((at-lot["time"]).total_seconds())),
+                           "mfe": (lot["high"]-lot["price"]) * matched,
+                           "mae": (lot["low"]-lot["price"]) * matched})
+            lot["qty"] -= matched
+            remaining -= matched
+            if lot["qty"] == ZERO:
+                queues[symbol].pop(0)
+    return trades
+
+
+def compute_metrics(
+    results: BacktestResult | Mapping[str, Any] | Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]],
+    *, starting_capital: Decimal,
+    seed: int = 0,
+    bootstrap_samples: int = 2000,
+    small_sample_threshold: int = 30,
+    bars: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]] = (),
+) -> BacktestMetrics:
+    """Compute descriptive, cost-aware statistics from persisted fills/results."""
+    if isinstance(results, BacktestResult):
+        fills = results.fills
+        curve = results.equity_curve
+    elif isinstance(results, Mapping):
+        fills = results.get("fills", ())
+        curve = results.get("equity_curve", ())
+    else:
+        fills = results
+        curve = ()
+    capital = _decimal(starting_capital)
+    trades = _trade_records(fills)
+    cumulative = capital
+    generated_curve: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    peak = capital
+    max_dd = ZERO
+    for trade in trades:
+        cumulative += trade["pnl"]
+        peak = max(peak, cumulative)
+        if peak:
+            max_dd = max(max_dd, (peak-cumulative)/peak)
+        generated_curve.append({"time": trade["exit_time"], "cash": cumulative, "equity": cumulative})
+    equity = tuple(curve) if curve else tuple(generated_curve)
+    net_pnl = sum((t["pnl"] for t in trades), ZERO)
+    gross_wins = sum((t["pnl"] for t in trades if t["pnl"] > ZERO), ZERO)
+    gross_losses = -sum((t["pnl"] for t in trades if t["pnl"] < ZERO), ZERO)
+    wins = [t["pnl"] for t in trades if t["pnl"] > ZERO]
+    losses = [t["pnl"] for t in trades if t["pnl"] < ZERO]
+    n = len(trades)
+    expectancy = net_pnl / n if n else ZERO
+    by_symbol: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(list)
+    by_month: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(list)
+    by_tod: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(list)
+    for t in trades:
+        local = t["entry_time"].astimezone(NEW_YORK)
+        by_symbol[t["symbol"]].append(t)
+        by_month[local.strftime("%Y-%m")].append(t)
+        bucket = f"{local.hour:02d}:{(local.minute//30)*30:02d}"
+        by_tod[bucket].append(t)
+    summarize = lambda groups: {key: {"count": len(vals), "net_pnl": sum((x["pnl"] for x in vals), ZERO),
+                                       "win_rate": Decimal(sum(x["pnl"] > ZERO for x in vals))/len(vals)}
+                                for key, vals in sorted(groups.items())}
+    sample_ci = None
+    if n and bootstrap_samples > 0:
+        rng = random.Random(seed)
+        samples = sorted(sum((trades[rng.randrange(n)]["pnl"] for _ in range(n)), ZERO)/n
+                         for _ in range(bootstrap_samples))
+        sample_ci = (samples[int((bootstrap_samples-1)*Decimal("0.025"))],
+                     samples[int((bootstrap_samples-1)*Decimal("0.975"))])
+    warnings = (f"small sample: {n} closed trades; threshold is {small_sample_threshold}",) if n < small_sample_threshold else ()
+    excursions: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for t in trades:
+        holding = [b for b in bars if str(b["symbol"]).upper() == t["symbol"] and
+                   t["entry_time"] <= _dt(b["time"]) <= t["exit_time"]]
+        if holding:
+            high = max(_decimal(b["high"]) for b in holding)
+            low = min(_decimal(b["low"]) for b in holding)
+            t["mfe"] = max(ZERO, high-t["entry_price"])*t["quantity"]
+            t["mae"] = min(ZERO, low-t["entry_price"])*t["quantity"]
+        excursions.append({"symbol": t["symbol"], "entry_time": t["entry_time"], "mfe": t["mfe"], "mae": t["mae"]})
+    utilization = ZERO
+    if equity:
+        max_equity = max((_decimal(p.get("equity", p.get("cash", capital))) for p in equity), default=capital)
+        notionals = [sum((_decimal(f["quantity"])*_decimal(f["price"]) for f in fills
+                          if str(f["side"]).upper() in ("BUY", "B")), ZERO)]
+        utilization = min(Decimal(1), (notionals[0]/max_equity) if max_equity else ZERO)
+    final_cash = cumulative if not equity else _decimal(equity[-1].get("cash", equity[-1].get("equity", cumulative)))
+    final_equity = cumulative if not equity else _decimal(equity[-1].get("equity", final_cash))
+    return BacktestMetrics(
+        total_return=(final_equity-capital)/capital,
+        net_return=net_pnl/capital,
+        cash=final_cash,
+        equity_curve=equity,
+        trades=tuple(trades),
+        max_drawdown=max_dd,
+        profit_factor=None if gross_losses == ZERO else gross_wins/gross_losses,
+        win_rate=Decimal(len(wins))/n if n else ZERO,
+        average_win=sum(wins, ZERO)/len(wins) if wins else None,
+        average_loss=sum(losses, ZERO)/len(losses) if losses else None,
+        expectancy_net=expectancy,
+        mfe_mae=tuple(excursions), by_symbol=summarize(by_symbol), by_month=summarize(by_month),
+        by_time_of_day=summarize(by_tod), capital_utilization=utilization, sample_size=n,
+        expectancy_bootstrap_ci=sample_ci, warnings=warnings,
+    )
+
+
+class BacktestRunner:
+    """Run registered strategies over a supplied replay feed and simulator."""
+    def __init__(self, registry: StrategyRegistry, feed: HistoricalReplayFeed,
+                 clock: ReplayClock, execution: HistoricalExecutionSimulator,
+                 *, scheduler: StrategyScheduler | None = None,
+                 intent_factory: Callable[..., Any] | None = None,
+                 budget_policy: Any = None, eligibility_policy: Any = None,
+                 position_coordinator: Any = None, cycle_accounting: Any = None,
+                 protection_math: Any = None) -> None:
+        self.registry, self.feed, self.clock, self.execution = registry, feed, clock, execution
+        self.scheduler = scheduler or StrategyScheduler(clock)
+        self.intent_factory = intent_factory
+        self.policies = (budget_policy, eligibility_policy, position_coordinator, cycle_accounting, protection_math)
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _reject_real_broker(broker: object | None, execution: object) -> None:
+        for candidate in (broker, execution):
+            if candidate is None:
+                continue
+            module = type(candidate).__module__.lower()
+            name = type(candidate).__name__.lower()
+            environment = str(getattr(candidate, "environment", "")).lower()
+            if "alpaca" in module or "alpaca" in name or environment in {"paper", "live"}:
+                raise ValueError("real Alpaca/paper/live broker clients are refused in backtests")
+
+    async def run(self, request: BacktestRequest) -> BacktestResult:
+        self._reject_real_broker(request.broker, self.execution)
+        role = PeriodRole(request.period_role)
+        provenance = self.feed.provenance
+        strategies = []
+        for strategy_id in request.strategy_ids:
+            cls = self.registry.get(strategy_id, request.strategy_versions.get(strategy_id))
+            strategies.append(cls)
+        effective = dict(request.config)
+        effective.update({"seed": request.seed, "strategy_ids": list(request.strategy_ids),
+                          "strategy_versions": {c.spec.strategy_id:c.spec.version for c in strategies},
+                          "strategy_params": request.strategy_params})
+        digest = config_hash(effective)
+        if role is PeriodRole.HOLDOUT:
+            lock = request.holdout_lock
+            if lock is None:
+                raise HoldoutViolationError("HOLDOUT requires an explicit holdout lock token")
+            if lock.research_config_hash != digest:
+                raise HoldoutViolationError("holdout config differs from locked research configuration")
+            if request.window_start.astimezone(UTC) < lock.window_start or request.window_end.astimezone(UTC) > lock.window_end:
+                raise HoldoutViolationError("HOLDOUT run must stay within locked holdout window")
+            access = {"token": lock.token, "accessed_at": self.clock.now()}
+        else:
+            access = None
+            lock = request.holdout_lock
+            if lock and request.window_start.astimezone(UTC) < lock.window_end and request.window_end.astimezone(UTC) > lock.window_start:
+                raise HoldoutViolationError("research/dev window overlaps locked holdout window")
+        dataset_hash = provenance.dataset_hash or ""
+        run_id = hashlib.sha256(canonical_json({"config_hash":digest,"dataset_hash":dataset_hash,
+                            "symbols":sorted(request.symbols),"start":request.window_start,
+                            "end":request.window_end,"role":role.value}).encode()).hexdigest()
+        assumptions = self.execution.assumptions

+"""Immutable, content-addressed backtest run manifests.
+
+Manifests and run results are stored in run-scoped files by :mod:`runner`; the
+existing SQLite schema is deliberately unchanged for this task.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+import subprocess
+from dataclasses import dataclass, fields, is_dataclass
+from datetime import UTC, datetime
+from decimal import Decimal
+from enum import StrEnum
+from pathlib import Path
+from types import MappingProxyType
+from typing import Any, Mapping
+
+
+class PeriodRole(StrEnum):
+    RESEARCH = "RESEARCH"
+    DEV = "DEV"
+    HOLDOUT = "HOLDOUT"
+
+
+class HoldoutViolationError(ValueError):
+    """A holdout access or retuning rule was violated."""
+
+
+def canonical_json(value: Any) -> str:
+    """Canonical JSON for manifest/config/result hashing; rejects floats."""
+    def normalize(item: Any) -> Any:
+        if isinstance(item, datetime):
+            if item.tzinfo is None or item.utcoffset() is None:
+                raise ValueError("datetimes must be timezone-aware")
+            return item.astimezone(UTC).isoformat(timespec="microseconds").replace("+00:00", "Z")
+        if hasattr(item, "value") and isinstance(item.value, (str, int)):
+            return item.value
+        if isinstance(item, float):
+            raise TypeError("floats are not allowed in canonical backtest values")
+        if isinstance(item, Mapping):
+            return {str(k): normalize(v) for k, v in item.items()}
+        if isinstance(item, (list, tuple)):
+            return [normalize(v) for v in item]
+        if isinstance(item, (str, int, bool)) or item is None:
+            return item
+        if hasattr(item, "as_mapping"):
+            return normalize(item.as_mapping())
+        if isinstance(item, Decimal):
+            if not item.is_finite():
+                raise ValueError("non-finite Decimal is not canonical")
+            return format(item, "f")
+        if is_dataclass(item):
+            return normalize({field.name: getattr(item, field.name) for field in fields(item)})
+        raise TypeError(f"unsupported canonical value {type(item).__name__}")
+
+    return json.dumps(normalize(value), sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=True)
+
+
+def config_hash(config: Mapping[str, Any]) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(canonical_json(config).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
+
+
+def code_revision(cwd: str | Path | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Capture local git commit and dirty status without network access."""
+    try:
+        commit = subprocess.run(
+            ["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], cwd=cwd, check=True, capture_output=True,
+            text=True, timeout=2,
+        ).stdout.strip()
+        dirty = bool(subprocess.run(
+            ["git", "status", "--porcelain"], cwd=cwd, check=True, capture_output=True,
+            text=True, timeout=2,
+        ).stdout.strip())
+    except (OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError):
+        commit, dirty = "unknown", False
+    return {"commit": commit, "dirty": dirty}
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class HoldoutLock:
+    """Operator authorization and locked research/window identity."""
+    token: str
+    research_config_hash: str
+    window_start: datetime
+    window_end: datetime
+    enabled: bool = True
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        if not self.token or not self.enabled:
+            raise HoldoutViolationError("holdout access requires an enabled explicit lock token")
+        for name in ("window_start", "window_end"):
+            value = getattr(self, name)
+            if value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
+                raise ValueError(f"{name} must be timezone-aware")
+            object.__setattr__(self, name, value.astimezone(UTC))
+        if self.window_end <= self.window_start:
+            raise ValueError("holdout window must be bounded and non-empty")
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class RunManifest:
+    run_id: str
+    created_at: datetime
+    config_hash: str
+    symbols: tuple[str, ...]
+    window_start: datetime
+    window_end: datetime
+    period_role: PeriodRole
+    code_revision: Mapping[str, Any]
+    data_provenance: Mapping[str, Any]
+    data_revision: str
+    data_vintage: str
+    dataset_hash: str
+    starting_capital: str
+    fee_assumptions: Mapping[str, Any]
+    slippage_assumptions: Mapping[str, Any]
+    fill_assumptions: Mapping[str, Any]
+    ambiguity_assumptions: Mapping[str, Any]
+    seed: int
+    strategies: tuple[Mapping[str, str], ...]
+    holdout_access: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        if not self.run_id or not self.config_hash:
+            raise ValueError("run_id and config_hash are required")
+        if not isinstance(self.period_role, PeriodRole):
+            object.__setattr__(self, "period_role", PeriodRole(self.period_role))
+        for name in ("created_at", "window_start", "window_end"):
+            dt = getattr(self, name)
+            if dt.tzinfo is None or dt.utcoffset() is None:
+                raise ValueError(f"{name} must be timezone-aware")
+            object.__setattr__(self, name, dt.astimezone(UTC))
+        if self.window_end <= self.window_start:
+            raise ValueError("window must be bounded and non-empty")
+        if not 1 <= len(self.symbols) <= 10:
+            raise ValueError("manifest requires 1-10 symbols")
+        object.__setattr__(self, "symbols", tuple(sorted({s.upper() for s in self.symbols})))
+        for name in ("code_revision", "data_provenance", "fee_assumptions", "slippage_assumptions",
+                     "fill_assumptions", "ambiguity_assumptions", "holdout_access"):
+            value = getattr(self, name)
+            if value is not None:
+                object.__setattr__(self, name, MappingProxyType(dict(value)))
+        object.__setattr__(self, "strategies", tuple(MappingProxyType(dict(v)) for v in self.strategies))
+        if isinstance(self.seed, bool) or not isinstance(self.seed, int):
+            raise ValueError("seed must be int")
+
+    def canonical(self) -> str:
+        return canonical_json({field.name: getattr(self, field.name) for field in fields(self)})
+
+    @property
+    def content_hash(self) -> str:
+        return hashlib.sha256(self.canonical().encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
+
+    @classmethod
+    def from_json(cls, value: str) -> "RunManifest":
+        raw = json.loads(value)
+        for field in ("created_at", "window_start", "window_end"):
+            raw[field] = datetime.fromisoformat(raw[field].replace("Z", "+00:00"))
+        raw["period_role"] = PeriodRole(raw["period_role"])
+        raw["symbols"] = tuple(raw["symbols"])
+        raw["strategies"] = tuple(raw["strategies"])
+        return cls(**raw)
+
+
+def write_manifest(manifest: RunManifest, directory: str | Path) -> Path:
+    """Create once; exclusive creation rejects any existing run id."""
+    target = Path(directory) / f"{manifest.run_id}.manifest.json"
+    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    payload = manifest.canonical()
+    with target.open("x", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as stream:
+        stream.write(payload)
+        stream.flush()
+        os.fsync(stream.fileno())
+    return target
